plugin_asdk_app_69b16f24bc488191aace1d08.longDescription:
The trivago MCP server lets users search for hotels and other accommodations by travel dates and location, from countries and cities to specific venues, landmarks, or other points of interest. Using the details provided, it returns tailored hotel options with prices from multiple booking sites, plus photos, key accommodation details, and helpful links to learn more. In simple terms, it gives AI assistants an efficient way to help users find the right stay at the right price.

You can use the trivago app for 

Search hotels by destination and dates:
"Find me a hotel in Las Vegas for 2 people from 12 July to 20 July 2026"

Find budget accommodation near landmarks:
"I need a cheap accommodation near the Eiffel Tower for 1 night the 12th of June 2026"

Book hotels near event venues:
"Find me a hotel near the Etihad Stadium for 12 July to 14 July 2026"

Coordinate travel with conferences:
"I need accommodation close to the venue of the next KubeCon happening in Europe in 2026"

Plan family vacations:
"I am searching for 2 rooms for 2 adults and 2 children aged 6 and 10 in Barcelona for Easter 2026"
plugin_asdk_app_69b16f24bc488191aace1d08.longDescriptionZh:
trivago MCP 服务器允许用户根据旅行日期和地点搜索酒店和其他住宿，从国家和城市到特定地点、地标或其他兴趣点。使用所提供的详细信息，它会返回定制的酒店选项，其中包括多个预订网站的价格、照片、主要住宿详细信息以及了解更多信息的有用链接。简单来说，它为人工智能助手提供了一种有效的方式来帮助用户以合适的价格找到合适的住宿。

您可以使用 trivago 应用程序 

按目的地和日期搜索酒店：
“2026 年 7 月 12 日至 7 月 20 日期间，为我在拉斯维加斯找到一家适合 2 人入住的酒店”

寻找靠近地标的经济住宿：
“我需要在 2026 年 6 月 12 日在埃菲尔铁塔附近找个便宜的住宿住一晚”

预订活动场地附近的酒店：
“为我寻找 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 14 日期间阿提哈德体育场附近的酒店”

协调差旅与会议：
“我需要靠近 2026 年在欧洲举行的下一届 KubeCon 会场的住宿”

计划家庭度假：
“我正在巴塞罗那寻找 2 间适合 2 名成人和 2 名 6 岁和 10 岁儿童的 2026 年复活节房间”

plugin_asdk_app_69e078610464819191c8114e.longDescription:
TABLEALL helps travelers and diners discover and reserve fine dining restaurants across Japan through ChatGPT. Users can search by region, area, or cuisine, check real-time availability, view course menus and pricing, review cancellation policies, and create reservations or reservation requests.

TABLEALL supports Michelin-starred restaurants and a wide range of cuisines including sushi, kaiseki, tempura, wagyu, French, Italian, and more. Payments are completed securely on TableAll's website after a payment link is returned.
plugin_asdk_app_69e078610464819191c8114e.longDescriptionZh:
TABLEALL 通过 ChatGPT 帮助旅行者和食客发现并预订日本各地的高级餐厅。用户可以按地区、区域或美食进行搜索，查看实时可用性，查看课程菜单和价格，查看取消政策，以及创建预订或预订请求。

TABLEALL 支持米其林星级餐厅和各种美食，包括寿司、怀石料理、天妇罗、和牛、法式、意大利式等。返回付款链接后，付款将在 TableAll 网站上安全地完成。

plugin_asdk_app_69d5132eaa908191a79e4ea0.longDescription:
A fantastic way to use maps with ChatGPT!

Ask it to display the map for somewhere, then scroll and zoom around. Discuss the visible area with ChatGPT, drop pins, and ask questions.

e.g. 

- "Open an interactive @AnyWhereMap"
- "Show me New York City in an interactive @AnyWhereMap"

Open the map, scroll to an area and ask:

- "What is in this area?"
- "Is this a nice place to visit?"

例如 

- “打开交互式@AnyWhereMap”
- “以互动方式向我展示纽约市@AnyWhereMap”

打开地图，滚动到某个区域并询问：

- “这个区域有什么？”
- “这是一个值得参观的好地方吗？”

plugin_asdk_app_69c1784c29208191a35b4dde.productIntro: 描述您想去的地方和想做的事情，然后跳过搜索。从 Wikiloc 的 7700 万条真实路线中获取量身定制的路线，这些路线由全球 2000 万户外爱好者共享。
plugin_asdk_app_69c1784c29208191a35b4dde.productIntroEn: Describe where you want to go and what you want to do, and skip the search. Get a tailored selection of trails from Wikiloc's 77 million authentic trails, shared by 20 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.
plugin_asdk_app_69c1784c29208191a35b4dde.longDescription:
Describe where you want to go and what you want to do, and skip the search. Get a tailored selection of trails from Wikiloc's 77 million authentic trails, shared by 20 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.

Ask for hiking routes near your destination, cycling paths that match your fitness level, or hidden trails locals love. Explore interactive trail maps with waypoints marking peaks, waterfalls, viewpoints, and other highlights mapped by the Wikiloc community. 

See over 140 million photos taken along the trails so you know what awaits before you plan your next adventure.

Try asking:

- "Find me family-friendly trails in Spain"
- "Show me mountain bike routes in the Alps around 20km"
- "I'm visiting Italy next week. Find me 3 beautiful hikes near the Dolomites with lake views"
- "I want to see the great cliffs of Ireland. Recommend me some hikes"
- "Show me some stunning hikes ideal for a weekend in California"
plugin_asdk_app_69c1784c29208191a35b4dde.longDescriptionZh:
描述您想去的地方和想做的事情，然后跳过搜索。从 Wikiloc 的 7700 万条真实路线中获取量身定制的路线，这些路线由全球 2000 万户外爱好者共享。

询问您目的地附近的徒步路线、适合您健身水平的自行车道，或者当地人喜爱的隐蔽小径。探索交互式路线地图，其中标记了 Wikiloc 社区绘制的山峰、瀑布、观景点和其他亮点的路点。 

查看沿步道拍摄的超过 1.4 亿张照片，以便您在计划下一次冒险之前了解等待着您的是什么。

尝试询问：

- “在西班牙找到适合家庭的小径”
- “显示阿尔卑斯山约 20 公里的山地自行车路线”
- “我下周要去意大利。为我找到 3 条多洛米蒂山附近美丽的徒步路线，欣赏湖景”
- “我想看看爱尔兰的伟大悬崖。推荐我一些徒步旅行”
- “向我展示一些非常适合在加利福尼亚度周末的令人惊叹的徒步旅行”
defaultPrompts: show me a trail with stunning lake views in Italy
defaultPromptsZh: 向我展示一条意大利迷人湖景步道

plugin_asdk_app_69b33963f0d8819192549e28.productIntro: 通过对话界面更快地查找和预订瑞安航空航班。只需告诉助理您想去的地点和时间，它就会搜索可用的航线，向您显示航班选项和价格，并引导您直接访问 Ryanair 网站以完成预订。
plugin_asdk_app_69b33963f0d8819192549e28.productIntroEn: Find and book Ryanair flights faster with a conversational interface. Simply tell the assistant where you want to go and when — it will search available routes, show you flight options with prices, and guide you directly to the Ryanair website to complete your booking.
plugin_asdk_app_69b33963f0d8819192549e28.longDescription:
Find and book Ryanair flights faster with a conversational interface. Simply tell the assistant where you want to go and when — it will search available routes, show you flight options with prices, and guide you directly to the Ryanair website to complete your booking.

**What you can do:**
- Search for destinations,  one-way or return flights by destination and date
- Browse available flights with fare information
- Get redirected to Ryanair's website to finalise your booking securely

No more clicking through multiple pages to find what you need. Just describe your trip and get straight to the relevant results.

*Booking and payment are completed directly on Ryanair.com. This assistant helps you find and select flights — it does not process payments or store personal data.*
plugin_asdk_app_69b33963f0d8819192549e28.longDescriptionZh:
通过对话界面更快地查找和预订瑞安航空航班。只需告诉助理您想去的地点和时间，它就会搜索可用的航线，向您显示航班选项和价格，并引导您直接访问 Ryanair 网站以完成预订。

**你可以做什么：**
- 按目的地和日期搜索目的地、单程或回程航班
- 浏览可用航班及其票价信息
- 重定向至瑞安航空网站以安全地完成您的预订

不再需要点击多个页面来查找您需要的内容。只需描述您的旅行即可直接获取相关结果。

*预订和付款直接在 Ryanair.com 上完成。该助手可帮助您查找和选择航班 - 它不处理付款或存储个人数据。*

plugin_asdk_app_6a63af40f7608191a4ab4d6e.productIntro: 通过世界上最大的免费徒步旅游平台 GuruWalk 探索任何城市。在免费旅游中，您无需支付任何预付费用，并根据您认为最终体验的价值向导游支付费用。 GuruWalk 还提供 1,000 多个城市的导游参观、一日游和免排队门票，从马德里、罗马到东京、布宜诺斯艾利斯和纽约。
plugin_asdk_app_6a63af40f7608191a4ab4d6e.productIntroEn: Explore any city with GuruWalk, the world's largest free walking tour platform. On a free tour you join at no upfront cost and pay the guide whatever you think the experience was worth at the end. GuruWalk also offers guided visits, day trips and skip-the-line tickets in more than 1,000 cities, from Madrid and Rome to Tokyo, Buenos Aires and New York.
plugin_asdk_app_6a63af40f7608191a4ab4d6e.longDescription:
Explore any city with GuruWalk, the world's largest free walking tour platform. On a free tour you join at no upfront cost and pay the guide whatever you think the experience was worth at the end. GuruWalk also offers guided visits, day trips and skip-the-line tickets in more than 1,000 cities, from Madrid and Rome to Tokyo, Buenos Aires and New York.

Just say where you're going and when. Each tour comes with its photo, real traveller ratings, the language it's run in, how long it lasts and the times still available for your dates, so you can compare options in one place.

GuruWalk doesn't charge you or complete the booking here. It takes you straight to the tour page on guruwalk.com to finish there, and it can answer the practical questions first: how cancellation works, where the meeting point is, or how to book for a group, using GuruWalk's official support guides.
plugin_asdk_app_6a63af40f7608191a4ab4d6e.longDescriptionZh:

plugin_asdk_app_69fb11d13c4c8191b6ed5cd9.name: World Airfares
plugin_asdk_app_69fb11d13c4c8191b6ed5cd9.productIntro: 世界机票航班搜索将实时航班搜索直接带入您的 ChatGPT 对话中。只需告诉 ChatGPT 您想要飞行的地点和时间，即可从实时航班库存中获得即时结果 - 无需切换应用程序，无需切换选项卡。
plugin_asdk_app_69fb11d13c4c8191b6ed5cd9.productIntroEn: World Airfares Flight Search brings real-time flight search directly into your ChatGPT conversation. Simply tell ChatGPT where and when you want to fly, and get instant results from a live flight inventory - no app switching, no tab juggling.
plugin_asdk_app_69fb11d13c4c8191b6ed5cd9.longDescription:
World Airfares Flight Search brings real-time flight search directly into your ChatGPT conversation. Simply tell ChatGPT where and when you want to fly, and get instant results from a live flight inventory - no app switching, no tab juggling.

Browse results by recommended picks, airline, or all available options. Filter by travel dates, cabin class, and passengers. Each result shows full flight details including stops, duration, baggage, and pricing. When you're ready, tap Book Now to go straight to the booking page.

Built on the World Airfares API, this app covers one-way, round-trip, and multi-city itineraries across hundreds of airlines worldwide.
plugin_asdk_app_69fb11d13c4c8191b6ed5cd9.longDescriptionZh:
世界机票航班搜索将实时航班搜索直接带入您的 ChatGPT 对话中。只需告诉 ChatGPT 您想要飞行的地点和时间，即可从实时航班库存中获得即时结果 - 无需切换应用程序，无需切换选项卡。

按推荐精选、航空公司或所有可用选项浏览结果。按旅行日期、舱位和乘客进行筛选。每个结果都会显示完整的航班详细信息，包括经停、持续时间、行李和价格。准备好后，点击“立即预订”即可直接进入预订页面。

该应用程序基于世界机票 API 构建，涵盖全球数百家航空公司的单程、往返和多城市行程。

plugin_asdk_app_694502d7182881919a9119bb.productIntro: 探索您在 ChatGPT 的理想酒店，并以最优惠的直接价格预订。
plugin_asdk_app_694502d7182881919a9119bb.productIntroEn: Discover your ideal hotel in ChatGPT and book at the best direct rates.
plugin_asdk_app_694502d7182881919a9119bb.longDescription:
Discover your ideal hotel in ChatGPT and book at the best direct rates.

The Hotels Network app brings hotel-verified details and prices from the hotel’s official site into your chat, so you can compare confidently and then finish your booking on the hotel’s own checkout.

Describe your stay naturally (location, dates, key amenities) and get a personalized list of best-matching hotel options with photos, amenities, policies, and current prices. When ready to complete the booking, tap “Book direct.”

Find great hotel deals, unlock exclusive direct offers, and enjoy added flexibility by booking directly with a hotel.
plugin_asdk_app_694502d7182881919a9119bb.longDescriptionZh:
探索您在 ChatGPT 的理想酒店，并以最优惠的直接价格预订。

Hotels Network 应用程序将酒店官方网站上经过酒店验证的详细信息和价格带入您的聊天中，以便您可以自信地进行比较，然后在酒店自己的结帐处完成预订。

自然地描述您的住宿（地点、日期、主要设施），并获得最匹配酒店选项的个性化列表，其中包含照片、设施、政策和当前价格。准备好完成预订时，请点击“直接预订”。

查找超值酒店优惠，解锁独家直接优惠，并通过直接向酒店预订享受更大的灵活性。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3e6f8666948191bbb4af07.productIntro: FLIGHTS 可查找真正适合您旅行的航班，而不仅仅是最便宜的机票。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3e6f8666948191bbb4af07.productIntroEn: FLIGHTS finds flights that actually fit your trip—not just the cheapest ticket.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3e6f8666948191bbb4af07.longDescription:
FLIGHTS finds flights that actually fit your trip—not just the cheapest ticket.

Share your itinerary, dates, and preferences to get routes matched to your whole plan: arrival times that work with hotel check-in, layovers that don't consume a travel day, and multi-city routes built around the places you'll visit. Compare prices, direct flights, and budget alternatives—then book wherever works best.

Don't have an itinerary yet? FLIGHTS can help you build your trip around the flight. Find the right route first, then book at the best price.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3e6f8666948191bbb4af07.longDescriptionZh:
FLIGHTS 可查找真正适合您旅行的航班，而不仅仅是最便宜的机票。

分享您的行程、日期和偏好，以获得与您的整个计划相匹配的路线：与酒店登记入住相关的到达时间、不占用旅行一天的中转时间以及围绕您将要参观的地点构建的多城市路线。比较价格、直飞航班和预算选择，然后预订最合适的地方。

还没有行程吗？ FLIGHTS 可以帮助您围绕航班打造您的旅行。首先找到正确的路线，然后以最优惠的价格预订。

plugin_asdk_app_69452c927b948191b2ea4515.longDescription:
Search, compare, and book train, bus, flight, and ferry tickets across 46 countries in Europe, North America, South America, and Asia. Access real-time prices and schedules from 2,300+ transport providers.

Major operators include:
- Trains: Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, SNCF, Trenitalia, Renfe, Eurostar, ÖBB, Italo
- Buses: FlixBus, National Express, Greyhound, ALSA, Eurolines
- Flights: Major airlines including Ryanair, EasyJet, Lufthansa, American Airlines
- Ferries: Balearia, Fast Ferries, GNV, and more

Book tickets directly with instant mobile delivery. Compare journey times, prices, and connection options. Use when travelers need to find routes between cities, compare transport options across modes, or book intercity and international travel. All options unified in one search.
plugin_asdk_app_69452c927b948191b2ea4515.longDescriptionZh:
搜索、比较和预订欧洲、北美、南美和亚洲 46 个国家/地区的火车票、巴士票、航班票和渡轮票。访问 2,300 多家运输提供商的实时价格和时刻表。

- 火车：Amtrak、Deutsche Bahn、SNCF、Trenitalia、Renfe、欧洲之星、ÖBB、Italo
- 巴士：FlixBus、National Express、Greyhound、ALSA、Eurolines
- 航班：主要航空公司包括瑞安航空、易捷航空、汉莎航空、美国航空
- 渡轮：Balearia、Fast Ferries、GNV 等

通过即时移动交付直接预订门票。比较旅程时间、价格和转乘选项。当旅行者需要查找城市之间的路线、比较不同模式的交通选择或预订城际和国际旅行时使用。所有选项统一在一次搜索中。

plugin_asdk_app_69abcd7987808191a8d6751b.productIntro: AbhiBus AI Assistant 可以帮助旅客做出更好的巴士旅行决策，清楚地了解可用的选项。它是为发现和比较而设计的。
plugin_asdk_app_69abcd7987808191a8d6751b.productIntroEn: The AbhiBus AI Assistant helps travellers make better bus travel decisions with clear visibility into available options. It is designed for discovery and comparison.
plugin_asdk_app_69abcd7987808191a8d6751b.longDescription:
The AbhiBus AI Assistant helps travellers make better bus travel decisions with clear visibility into available options. It is designed for discovery and comparison.

Users can search routes and instantly explore bus availability with filters such as departure window, bus type (AC/Non-AC/Sleeper/Seater), operator, and budget. The assistant presents structured results so travelers can quickly understand what is available and choose confidently.

What this app is for:
- Better decision-making before booking
- Clear visibility into bus availability on a route
- Fast comparison of options by time, type, and price
- Conversational filtering based on traveler preferences

AbhiBus AI Assistant simplifies travel planning by turning raw availability data into clear, actionable choices.
plugin_asdk_app_69abcd7987808191a8d6751b.longDescriptionZh:
AbhiBus AI Assistant 可以帮助旅客做出更好的巴士旅行决策，清楚地了解可用的选项。它是为发现和比较而设计的。

用户可以搜索路线并通过出发窗口、巴士类型（空调/非空调/卧铺/座位）、运营商和预算等过滤器立即探索巴士可用性。助手会呈现结构化的结果，以便旅行者可以快速了解可用的内容并自信地进行选择。

这个应用程序的用途是：
- 预订前更好的决策
- 清楚地了解路线上的巴士可用性
- 按时间、类型和价格快速比较选项
- 基于旅行者偏好的对话过滤

AbhiBus AI Assistant 通过将原始可用性数据转化为清晰、可行的选择来简化旅行计划。

defaultPromptsZh: 搜索明天从 海得拉巴 到 班加罗尔 的巴士

plugin_asdk_app_6964b9f1c11c81919eefdc73.productIntroEn: Discover, compare, and book the perfect room for your stay among 5,700+ Accor hotels and residences in 110+ countries from smart economy to exceptional luxury.
plugin_asdk_app_6964b9f1c11c81919eefdc73.longDescription:
Discover, compare, and book the perfect room for your stay among 5,700+ Accor hotels and residences in 110+ countries from smart economy to exceptional luxury.

Whether you’re looking for a practical city break with ibis or ibis Styles, a comfortable stay with Novotel or Mercure, a lifestyle experience with Mama Shelter, JO&JOE, Tribe or 25hours, or an unforgettable luxury escape with Sofitel, Fairmont, Raffles, Orient Express or Banyan Tree, Accor offers the right brand for every journey and every mood.

Simply describe the experience you’re looking for in the ALL Accor app using ChatGPT.

Use the interactive map and list to view hotels and easily compare them based on prices, photos, available services, guest reviews and room availability.

Access member-exclusive rates instead of public ones if you’re already an ALL member or if you’re considering joining (membership is free, by the way, and yes, it’s worth it).

Plan your stay by asking questions such as:
- Show me romantic hotels in Paris with a spa for our honeymoon
- Find hotels available tonight within a budget of around €150
- Are there any nice French restaurants near this hotel?

Compare your options, explore the surroundings of your accommodation, and complete your booking seamlessly on ALL.com  with the confidence of choosing the right brand, at the right level, for the stay you actually want.
plugin_asdk_app_6964b9f1c11c81919eefdc73.longDescriptionZh:
在 110 多个国家/地区的 5,700 多家雅高酒店和公寓中探索、比较并预订最适合您住宿的客房，从智能经济型酒店到超凡豪华酒店应有尽有。

无论您是想在宜必思或宜必思尚品酒店享受实用的城市度假，在诺富特或美居酒店享受舒适的住宿，在 Mama Shelter、JO&JOE、Tribe 或 25hours 享受生活方式体验，还是在索菲特、费尔蒙、莱佛士、东方快车或悦榕庄享受难忘的奢华度假，雅高酒店都能为您的每一次旅程和每一种心情提供合适的品牌。

使用 ChatGPT 简单描述您在 ALL Accor 应用程序中寻找的体验。

使用交互式地图和列表查看酒店，并根据价格、照片、可用服务、宾客评论和客房供应情况轻松进行比较。

如果您已经是 ALL 会员或正在考虑加入（顺便说一下，会员资格是免费的，而且是值得的），您可以享受会员专享价格，而不是公开价格。

通过询问以下问题来计划您的住宿：
- 显示巴黎的浪漫酒店，为我们的蜜月提供水疗中心
- 查找今晚预算在 150 欧元左右的酒店
- 这家酒店附近有什么好吃的法国餐厅吗？

比较您的选择，探索您住宿的周边环境，并在 ALL.com 上无缝完成预订，放心地为您真正想要的住宿选择合适的品牌、合适的级别。

plugin_asdk_app_69434d007214819191b98d78.description: 了解如何到达任何地方
plugin_asdk_app_69434d007214819191b98d78.productIntro: Rome2Rio 帮助您了解如何前往世界任何地方。 询问任何行程（从当地路线到全球旅程），并立即了解如何乘坐火车、巴士、渡轮、汽车、航班甚至每种方式的组合到达目的地，所有这些都在一个地方。该地图可让您轻松查看和比较您的旅行选择。 您将获得清晰的门到门路线选择，包括行程时间、转机路线和预估价格。如果可用，Rome2Rio 还会显示时间表和门票详细信息，以便您可以放心地计划。
plugin_asdk_app_69434d007214819191b98d78.productIntroEn: Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world. Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.
plugin_asdk_app_69434d007214819191b98d78.longDescription:
Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world. 
Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.
You’ll get clear, door-to-door route options with travel times, connections, and estimated prices. When available, Rome2Rio also shows schedules and ticket details so you can plan with confidence.
Whether you’re comparing transport modes, mapping a complex itinerary, or making on-the-go decisions, Rome2Rio makes it easy to understand your options and choose the best way to get there.
plugin_asdk_app_69434d007214819191b98d78.longDescriptionZh:
Rome2Rio 帮助您了解如何前往世界任何地方。 
询问任何行程（从当地路线到全球旅程），并立即了解如何乘坐火车、巴士、渡轮、汽车、航班甚至每种方式的组合到达目的地，所有这些都在一个地方。该地图可让您轻松查看和比较您的旅行选择。
您将获得清晰的门到门路线选择，包括行程时间、转机路线和预估价格。如果可用，Rome2Rio 还会显示时间表和门票详细信息，以便您可以放心地计划。
无论您是在比较交通方式、绘制复杂的行程，还是在旅途中做出决定，Rome2Rio 都可以让您轻松了解您的选择并选择到达目的地的最佳方式。

plugin_asdk_app_69fce3fd9d548191ada96b14.productIntro: 洲际酒店集团酒店及度假村在 100 多个国家/地区拥有 7,000 多家酒店，为各类旅客提供真正的热情款待。从难忘的豪华住宿到可靠的舒适体验，无论您的旅程前往何处，洲际酒店集团都能帮助您找到合适的酒店。
plugin_asdk_app_69fce3fd9d548191ada96b14.productIntroEn: With 7,000+ hotels across 100+ countries, IHG Hotels & Resorts delivers true hospitality for every kind of traveler. From memorable luxury stays to dependable comfort, IHG helps you find the right hotel, wherever your journey takes you.
plugin_asdk_app_69fce3fd9d548191ada96b14.longDescription:
With 7,000+ hotels across 100+ countries, IHG Hotels & Resorts delivers true hospitality for every kind of traveler. From memorable luxury stays to dependable comfort, IHG helps you find the right hotel, wherever your journey takes you.

Discover iconic brands like InterContinental, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza, Hotel Indigo, Holiday Inn, and more, each offering a distinctive stay experience, united by a shared commitment to true hospitality. Whether you’re planning a business trip, city getaway, or seaside escape, IHG makes it easy to find a stay that fits your travel needs.

Plan your next getaway by simply describing your ideal stay in the IHG app with ChatGPT.

Try searches like:
"Find a hotel tonight nearby for less than $200"
"Show me hotels for the perfect romantic getaway"
"Where's the best hotel near the Mercedes-Benz Stadium?"

Easily explore our global portfolio, compare options, and plan your stay with ease. When you’re ready to book, complete your reservation securely on IHG.com.

Also, with IHG One Rewards, every stay is more rewarding. Members unlock exclusive rates, earn redeem points at thousands of hotels worldwide, and enjoy flexible booking benefits.

Let’s get started on your stay!
plugin_asdk_app_69fce3fd9d548191ada96b14.longDescriptionZh:
洲际酒店集团酒店及度假村在 100 多个国家/地区拥有 7,000 多家酒店，为各类旅客提供真正的热情款待。从难忘的豪华住宿到可靠的舒适体验，无论您的旅程前往何处，洲际酒店集团都能帮助您找到合适的酒店。

探索洲际酒店、金普顿酒店、皇冠假日酒店、英迪格酒店、假日酒店等标志性品牌，每个品牌都提供独特的住宿体验，并共同致力于真正的热情好客。无论您是计划商务旅行、城市度假还是海边度假，洲际酒店集团都能轻松找到适合您旅行需求的住宿。

通过 ChatGPT 在 IHG 应用程序中简单描述您的理想住宿体验，即可规划您的下一次度假。

尝试搜索如下：
“今晚在附近找一家价格低于 200 美元的酒店”
“显示适合完美浪漫之旅的酒店”
“梅赛德斯-奔驰体育场附近最好的酒店在哪里？”

轻松探索我们的全球产品组合、比较选项并轻松计划您的住宿。当您准备好预订时，请在 IHG.com 上安全地完成预订。

此外，通过 IHG One Rewards，每次入住都会获得更多回报。会员可解锁专享房价，在全球数千家酒店赚取兑换积分，并享受灵活的预订优惠。

让我们开始您的住宿吧！

plugin_asdk_app_69449934c13081918bb35ad9.productIntro: Reagent Travel 将航班搜索转变为引导式对话，帮助您快速找到正确的选项，而无需挖掘无穷无尽的结果列表。
plugin_asdk_app_69449934c13081918bb35ad9.productIntroEn: Reagent Travel turns flight search into a guided conversation, helping you quickly find the right option without digging through endless lists of results.
plugin_asdk_app_69449934c13081918bb35ad9.longDescription:
Reagent Travel turns flight search into a guided conversation, helping you quickly find the right option without digging through endless lists of results. 

Understand the key decision points for your trip by comparing trade-offs around price, schedule, stops, flexibility, comfort, and whatever else matters most - then discover better-fitting options as your priorities become clear. 

Compare choices in context, know why one flight fits better than another, and tap Book when you’ve found the right one.
plugin_asdk_app_69449934c13081918bb35ad9.longDescriptionZh:
Reagent Travel 将航班搜索转变为引导式对话，帮助您快速找到正确的选项，而无需挖掘无穷无尽的结果列表。 

通过比较价格、时间表、停靠点、灵活性、舒适度以及其他最重要的因素的权衡，了解您旅行的关键决策点 - 然后在您的优先事项变得清晰后发现更合适的选择。 

在上下文中比较选择，了解为什么一个航班比另一个航班更适合，并在找到合适的航班后点击“预订”。

plugin_asdk_app_698b770bca888191ab46ce45.name: Travel Advisory
plugin_asdk_app_698b770bca888191ab46ce45.productIntro: 随时了解情况。旅行更聪明。保持安全。
plugin_asdk_app_698b770bca888191ab46ce45.productIntroEn: Stay informed. Travel smarter. Stay safe.
plugin_asdk_app_698b770bca888191ab46ce45.longDescription:
Stay informed. Travel smarter. Stay safe.

Travel Advisory helps you understand safety, health, and risk conditions for countries around the world using official U.S. State Department travel advisories and related global indicators.

Before you book or travel, you can quickly check:

Official Travel Advisories
View government travel advisory levels, key safety concerns, and official warnings for any destination.

Traveler-Specific Risk Insights
Understand how safety conditions may differ for solo travelers, families, business trips, and remote workers.

Political & Stability Context
Review governance, freedom, and security indicators to better understand local conditions.

Country Comparisons
Compare travel advisories and risk factors across multiple countries to help choose between destinations.

Whether you’re planning a vacation, a work trip, or a long-term stay, Travel Advisory makes it easier to make informed travel decisions using clear, official safety information.

Try asking questions like:
- “Is France safe to visit right now?”
- “Which is safer for travel, Mexico or Costa Rica?”
- “How risky is this destination for families?”
- “What are the main safety concerns in this country?”

Travel Advisory is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.
Advisory information reflects the latest published updates from official sources and is refreshed daily.
© 2026 TravelAdvisory. Built with love for travelers and developers worldwide.
plugin_asdk_app_698b770bca888191ab46ce45.longDescriptionZh:
随时了解情况。旅行更聪明。保持安全。

旅行咨询使用美国国务院官方旅行咨询和相关全球指标，帮助您了解世界各国的安全、健康和风险状况。

在预订或旅行之前，您可以快速查看：

官方旅行建议
查看任何目的地的政府旅行咨询级别、主要安全问题以及官方警告。

针对旅行者的风险洞察
了解单独旅行者、家庭、商务旅行和远程工作人员的安全条件有何不同。

政治与稳定背景
审查治理、自由和安全指标，以更好地了解当地情况。

国家比较
比较多个国家/地区的旅行建议和风险因素，以帮助选择目的地。

无论您是计划度假、出差还是长期住宿，旅行咨询都可以利用清晰的官方安全信息让您更轻松地做出明智的旅行决定。

尝试提出以下问题：
- “现在去法国安全吗？”
- “墨西哥和哥斯达黎加哪个旅行更安全？”
- “这个目的地对于家庭来说有多大风险？”
- “这个国家主要的安全问题是什么？”

旅行咨询不隶属于美国政府，也不受美国政府认可。
咨询信息反映了官方来源最新发布的更新，并且每天更新。
© 2026 旅游咨询。怀着对世界各地旅行者和开发商的热爱而建造。

Plan smarter trips with flights, hotels, fare insights, and real-time travel updates - all within ChatGPT, powered by ixigo.

Search and compare one-way and round-trip flights across domestic and international routes with live fares, schedules, and flexible filtering. Discover hotels with your preferences - whether you're looking near a landmark, in a specific area, or with amenities like free breakfast,  jacuzzi, or couple-friendly stays.

Stay updated with live flight tracking and use fare intelligence to explore price trends across nearby dates, helping you find better deals. For last-mile travel, seamlessly continue to ixigo for cab bookings.

The experience adapts to your intent and prompts for missing details when needed, making travel planning faster, more intuitive, and personalized.

plugin_asdk_app_695e7c4731d4819185471e24.productIntro: Bed-and-Breakfast.it 是一款应用程序，旨在帮助旅行者直接与业主发现并预订正宗的意大利住宿，无需佣金或中介。
plugin_asdk_app_695e7c4731d4819185471e24.productIntroEn: Bed-and-Breakfast.it is an app designed to help travelers discover and book authentic Italian accommodations directly with the property owners, without commissions or intermediaries.
plugin_asdk_app_695e7c4731d4819185471e24.longDescription:
Bed-and-Breakfast.it is an app designed to help travelers discover and book authentic Italian accommodations directly with the property owners, without commissions or intermediaries.

The app provides access to thousands of bed and breakfasts, vacation rentals, agriturismi and guesthouses across Italy, all managed by independent hosts. Availability and prices are provided directly by the accommodations, ensuring transparency, direct contact and fair conditions for both travelers and hosts.

Users can search by destination, dates and preferences, explore detailed property profiles, and interact with real hosts for tailored information. Where available, instant booking allows travelers to confirm their stay immediately, while maintaining a direct relationship with the accommodation.

With over twenty years of experience in the Italian hospitality market, Bed-and-Breakfast.it focuses on simplicity, trust and sustainability, offering a practical alternative to large commission-based booking platforms.
plugin_asdk_app_695e7c4731d4819185471e24.longDescriptionZh:
Bed-and-Breakfast.it 是一款应用程序，旨在帮助旅行者直接与业主发现并预订正宗的意大利住宿，无需佣金或中介。

该应用程序提供意大利各地数千家住宿加早餐酒店、度假出租屋、农家乐和宾馆的访问权限，所有这些均由独立房东管理。住宿供应情况和价格由住宿直接提供，确保游客和房东的透明度、直接联系和公平条件。

用户可以按目的地、日期和偏好进行搜索，探索详细的房产概况，并与真实的房东互动以获取定制信息。在可行的情况下，即时预订允许旅客立即确认其住宿，同时与住宿保持直接关系。

Bed-and-Breakfast.it 在意大利酒店市场拥有二十多年的经验，专注于简单、信任和可持续发展，为大型佣金预订平台提供实用的替代方案。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed002cd148191919d0737.productIntroEn: Travel effortlessly through Europe with the official Eurostar ChatGPT app. We provide real-time Eurostar schedules, fares and availability so you can find and book the best trains without leaving your chat. Our live data covers all Eurostar routes across France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and the UK.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed002cd148191919d0737.longDescription:
Travel effortlessly through Europe with the official Eurostar ChatGPT app. We provide real-time Eurostar schedules, fares and availability so you can find and book the best trains without leaving your chat. Our live data covers all Eurostar routes across France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and the UK.

- Popular routes: Quickly check the schedules and fares for London to Paris, London to Brussels, London to Amsterdam & Rotterdam, and Paris to Brussels, Amsterdam, Rotterdam. These high-speed connections run frequently between city centres (e.g., London St Pancras to Paris Gare du Nord).
- Full Eurostar network: Plan trips to Cologne, Lille, Antwerp, Ghent, Düsseldorf, and Liège. Some journeys require a change; our app will clearly label these.
- Effortless booking: See live fares and then book in seconds. Tap Book on Eurostar on your chosen itinerary, and we’ll deep-link you to Eurostar.com with your trip pre-loaded in the basket for fast checkout.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed002cd148191919d0737.longDescriptionZh:
使用欧洲之星官方 ChatGPT 应用程序轻松游历欧洲。我们提供实时欧洲之星时刻表、票价和可用性，因此您无需离开聊天即可找到并预订最好的火车。我们的实时数据涵盖法国、比利时、荷兰、德国和英国的所有欧洲之星航线。

- 热门路线：快速查看伦敦至巴黎、伦敦至布鲁塞尔、伦敦至阿姆斯特丹和鹿特丹、巴黎至布鲁塞尔、阿姆斯特丹、鹿特丹的时刻表和票价。这些高速连接在市中心之间频繁运行（例如，从伦敦圣潘克拉斯到巴黎北站）。
- 完整的欧洲之星网络：计划前往科隆、里尔、安特卫普、根特、杜塞尔多夫和列日的旅行。有些旅程需要改变；我们的应用程序将清楚地标记这些。
- 轻松预订：查看实时票价，然后在几秒钟内预订。点击您选择的行程中的“在欧洲之星预订”，我们会将您深层链接到 Eurostar.com，并将您的行程预先加载到购物篮中，以便快速结帐。

plugin_asdk_app_69835ac4865c8191bd0801e5.productIntro: TravExp 将规划符合您品味的旅行的时间缩短高达 90%，因此您可以花更多的时间享受体验，而不必花太多时间在细节上。
plugin_asdk_app_69835ac4865c8191bd0801e5.productIntroEn: TravExp slashes the time to plan a trip that matches your taste by up to 90%, so you can spend more time enjoying the experience and less time stressing over details.
plugin_asdk_app_69835ac4865c8191bd0801e5.longDescription:
TravExp slashes the time to plan a trip that matches your taste by up to 90%, so you can spend more time enjoying the experience and less time stressing over details.

This app elevates your travel planning experience on ChatGPT by directly integrating into the conversation flow.  You can instantly turn ChatGPT-generated itineraries into rich, visual trip plans that are editable and collaborative. You can even create a brand-new personalized itinerary right from the chat. TravExp creates beautiful, visual itineraries packed with essential details, including places to visit, reviews, seasonal insights, must-do activities, and more.

You can also easily setup a planning workspace by directly opening the itinerary on TravExp where you can leverage supporting features like navigation, local tips, exclusive deals, packing essentials, and AI-powered travel assistance.
plugin_asdk_app_69835ac4865c8191bd0801e5.longDescriptionZh:
TravExp 将规划符合您品味的旅行的时间缩短高达 90%，因此您可以花更多的时间享受体验，而不必花太多时间在细节上。

该应用程序通过直接集成到对话流程中来提升您在 ChatGPT 上的旅行计划体验。  您可以立即将 ChatGPT 生成的行程转变为可编辑和协作的丰富、可视化旅行计划。您甚至可以直接通过聊天创建全新的个性化行程。 TravExp 创建精美、可视化的行程，其中包含基本细节，包括参观地点、评论、季节性见解、必做活动等。

您还可以通过直接在 TravExp 上打开行程来轻松设置规划工作区，在其中您可以利用导航、本地提示、独家优惠、打包必需品和人工智能旅行帮助等支持功能。

plugin_asdk_app_694b31eb6ac4819198feceab.longDescription:
DirectBooker — Book hotels direct for better rates and better service

DirectBooker helps you discover, compare, and book hotels at your destination for all your travel planning needs. Find accommodation in the right neighborhood, with the right vibe, and the amenities you need. See photos, real-time rates and availability for every property. Unlock member prices and special packages available only when you book directly. 

And when you book, you book straight with the hotel on their official website, so you get the direct rate and keep everything you've earned: points, elite status and benefits, and exclusive member offers. DirectBooker helps you find great rates for booking independent and boutique hotels, as well as  hotels from all major hotel brands worldwide, including as Best Western, Choice, Hilton, Hyatt, Marriott, Radisson, and more. 

From a last-minute airport room tonight to a resort or wellness retreat booked weeks ahead, DirectBooker helps you plan your trip and book smarter.

Direct is best. Better rates, better service, better travel.

plugin_asdk_app_6a2ae7cbada08191a5294216.name: Kismet
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ae7cbada08191a5294216.productIntro: Kismet 将您直接连接到专业管理的度假出租屋集合（由专业经理管理的各种住宿类型，从两人度假的隐居处到可供整个团聚入住的大院），以及您的人工智能实际规划旅行所需的深度，而不仅仅是搜索旅行。从真正的计划开始时就开始模糊（“十月在海岸上某个适合狗的地方”），然后让你的人工智能来做真正的工作：在一个询问中比较多个周末，包括它们之间的价格波动；在你爱上任何东西之前，查看经理费用和估计税费的真实总额——清洁费、宠物费以及他们披露的其他费用；而且永远不会陷入死胡同—…
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ae7cbada08191a5294216.productIntroEn: Kismet connects you directly to collections of professionally managed vacation rentals — every kind of stay professional managers run, from a hideaway for two to a compound that sleeps the whole reunion — with the depth your AI needs to actually plan a trip, not just search one.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ae7cbada08191a5294216.longDescription:
Kismet connects you directly to collections of professionally managed vacation rentals — every kind of stay professional managers run, from a hideaway for two to a compound that sleeps the whole reunion — with the depth your AI needs to actually plan a trip, not just search one. Start as vague as real plans start ("somewhere dog-friendly on the coast in October") and let your AI do the real work: compare multiple weekends in a single ask, including the price swings between them; see true totals with the manager's fees and estimated taxes counted — cleaning, pets, and the rest they disclose — before you fall in love with anything; and never hit a dead end — if your dates don't work, you get the nearest ones that do.

Every property carries full photo galleries, complete amenities, pet policies, house rules, and what past guests actually say, so weighing a pet-friendly cabin for two against a beach house for the whole family happens in one conversation instead of a dozen open tabs. Shortlist your finalists, then book direct on the manager's own site — your exact dates carried through, rates straight from the manager, no marketplace service fees added on top.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ae7cbada08191a5294216.longDescriptionZh:
Kismet 将您直接连接到专业管理的度假出租屋集合（由专业经理管理的各种住宿类型，从两人度假的隐居处到可供整个团聚入住的大院），以及您的人工智能实际规划旅行所需的深度，而不仅仅是搜索旅行。从真正的计划开始时就开始模糊（“十月在海岸上某个适合狗的地方”），然后让你的人工智能来做真正的工作：在一个询问中比较多个周末，包括它们之间的价格波动；在你爱上任何东西之前，查看经理费用和估计税费的真实总额——清洁费、宠物费以及他们披露的其他费用；而且永远不会陷入死胡同——如果你的约会不成功，你会找到最近的合适的。

每处房产都配有完整的照片库、完整的便利设施、宠物政策、入住须知以及过去客人的真实评价，因此只需一次对话即可权衡适合两人入住的宠物友好型小屋与适合全家入住的海滨别墅，而不是一打打开的选项卡。列出您的决赛入围者，然后直接在经理自己的网站上预订 - 您的确切日期进行，价格直接来自经理，不添加任何市场服务费。

plugin_asdk_app_694527b6431c8191856a50b7.longDescription:
Find the right car rental anywhere in the world, fast and without hassle.

The DiscoverCars.com app helps you compare car rental offers from hundreds of trusted suppliers in one place. You can quickly see prices, car types, insurance options and rental conditions, so you can book with confidence and avoid surprises at pickup.

What you can do
- Compare car rental prices across local and global providers  
- See clear rental terms before you book  
- Choose the right insurance and fuel policy for your trip  
- Find cars at airports and city locations worldwide  
- Book in minutes with instant confirmation  

Why choose DiscoverCars.com?
- Transparency - see the full price, deposit amount and rental conditions before you book  
- Trusted by customers - 4.6 rating on Trustpilot based on 250,000+ reviews  
- Recognized by the industry - 6-time World Travel Awards winner  
- Global coverage - 1000+ suppliers across 10,000 locations worldwide  
- Car rental focus - a product built entirely around car rentals, nothing else  

What users appreciate
- Saves time by showing the best options in one view  
- Clear pricing with no hidden fees  
- Filters that make it easy to find the right car for your needs  
- Support from a team that deals only with car rentals  

Whether you are planning a weekend trip or a long vacation, DiscoverCars.com makes car rental simple and stress free.

Whether you're planning a family vacation, business stay, or road trip, you can explore your options before seamlessly continuing to Wyndham Hotels & Resorts to book directly.

Explore thousands of hotels in more than 95 countries across trusted brands for every travel preference and budget, including economy brands like Super 8®, Days Inn®, Microtel®, and Travelodge®; midscale brands like La Quinta®, Baymont®, Ramada®, and Wingate®; and upscale brands like Wyndham®, Wyndham Grand®, Dolce®, and Registry Collection Hotels®.

tiket.com is a pioneer online travel agent (OTA) in Indonesia, established in 2011. It is one of the largest and most comprehensive online travel companies in the country, offering flight tickets, train tickets, accommodations, villas & apartments, event tickets, car rentals, and other travel-related services. In 2017, tiket.com became affiliated with Blibli, and in 2021 officially became a consolidated subsidiary of Blibli. Blibli operates a unified omnichannel ecosystem known as Blibli Tiket, which comprises its subsidiaries tiket.com, Ranch Market and Dekoruma. This ecosystem synergy enhances customer convenience and delivers added value by providing more comprehensive, beneficial, and integrated services across every channel and platform. plugin_asdk_app_69f47105a4f0819197705839.longDescription:

No forms, no redirects to a website. Just tell the app where you want to go and when, confirm the option you like, and get your ticket by email.
Covers 50+ destinations and 40+ local boat operators, including Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao, Bangkok, Phi Phi, Phuket, Krabi, Koh Lanta, and Koh Lipe — plus access to every island in Thailand. Compares routes by speed, price, and comfort, and handles multi-leg journeys that combine bus and ferry, or several ferries in a row, as a single booking.
Often cheaper than booking each leg separately, with a faster, simpler flow than traditional booking sites. Every booking is double-checked by a human team based in Thailand, so connection times actually work. Real support is available any time at no extra cost — through ChatGPT, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, or Telegram.
Pay in any major currency with cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Alipay, WeChat Pay, and more. Officially licensed and registered in Thailand.

plugin_asdk_app_6985d45803d08191bc0f0e90.longDescription:
Was your flight delayed, cancelled, or were you denied boarding? 

AirHelp tells you in seconds when you're owed compensation — and how much. Just fill in your flight details and we’ll estimate your payout. Connecting journeys with missed connections are covered too. 

When you're eligible, you can start your claim right away.

AirHelp has checked over 25 million claims under EU, UK, Turkish and Brazilian laws. We can get you the compensation you’re owed, but we can’t assist with flight refunds, baggage or travel insurance claims. 
eal-time flight status, hotel or car rental bookings, or general trip planning.

您的航班是否延误、取消或被拒绝登机？

当您符合资格时，您可以立即开始索赔。

AirHelp 已根据欧盟、英国、土耳其和巴西法律检查了超过 2500 万起索赔。我们可以为您获得应得的赔偿，但我们无法协助您办理航班退款、行李或旅行保险索赔。

Search, compare, and book airport transfers, airport taxis, ride-hailing, shuttles and ski transfers across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Oceania, and Africa.

@hoppa is a global mobility platform offering seamless door-to-door ground transportation across 182+ countries, 2,600+ airports, and thousands of resorts. We empower 40 million+ customers to instantly compare and book the best fares for airport transfers, private taxis, ride-hailing, and shared shuttles in one place.

With real-time access to a network of 70,000+ vetted local providers, @hoppa ensures reliable fixed-price travel tailored to every journey and budget. Trusted by the world’s leading payment networks, including Mastercard, Visa, UnionPay, and Alipay, we simplify last-mile travel for every traveller.
How to use @hoppa: Ask the @hoppa app to compare routes or find the most cost-effective way to reach your destination. You can filter by vehicle type, price, or travel time to ensure your arrival is as smooth as your flight.

Key Features:
1: Compare & Save: Instant access to private transfers, shared shuttles, and taxis.
2: Global Reach: Coverage in 182+ countries and 2,600+ airports.
3: Fixed Pricing: No hidden fees; know what you pay before you book.
4: Vetted Providers: 70,000+ reliable local fleets.

Useful for:
1: Planning stress-free transport before you land.
2: Comparing ride-hailing vs private transfers in real-time.
3: Securing reliable transport for large groups or solo holiday travel.

Conversation Starters (Try asking)
“@hoppa, find a private transfer from Barcelona Airport to the City Centre.”
“@hoppa, what are the cheapest shuttle options from Malaga Airport?”
“@hoppa, book a taxi from Heathrow to Central London for 4 people.”
“@hoppa, show me airport transportation options in Miami airport.”
plugin_asdk_app_69f0bbcd7fe08191a8d6b83d.longDescriptionZh:
搜索、比较和预订欧洲、美洲、亚洲、大洋洲和非洲的机场接送、机场出租车、叫车、班车和滑雪接送。

@hoppa 是一个全球移动平台，提供跨越 182 多个国家、2,600 多个机场和数千个度假村的无缝门到门地面交通。我们帮助超过 4000 万客户在一个地方即时比较和预订机场接送、私人出租车、叫车和共享班车的最佳票价。

通过实时访问由 70,000 多家经过审查的本地提供商组成的网络，@hoppa 可确保为每一次旅程和预算量身定制可靠的固定价格旅行。我们受到万事达卡、Visa、银联和支付宝等世界领先支付网络的信赖，为每位旅客简化最后一英里的旅行。
如何使用@hoppa：使用@hoppa应用程序来比较路线或找到到达目的地的最经济有效的方式。您可以按车辆类型、价格或旅行时间进行筛选，以确保您的抵达与航班一样顺利。

主要特点：
1：比较并节省：即时使用私人接送服务、共享班车和出租车。
2：全球覆盖范围：覆盖 182 多个国家和 2,600 多个机场。
3：固定定价：无隐藏费用；在预订前了解您支付的费用。
4：经过审查的提供商：70,000 多个可靠的本地车队。

适用于：
1：在着陆前规划无压力的交通。
2：实时比较网约车与私人接送服务。
3：为大型团体或单独度假旅行提供可靠的交通。

对话开始者（尝试提问）
“@hoppa，找到从巴塞罗那机场到市中心的私人接送服务。”
“@hoppa，从马拉加机场出发最便宜的班车有哪些？”
“@hoppa，预订一辆从希思罗机场到伦敦市中心的 4 人出租车。”
“@hoppa，告诉我迈阿密机场的机场交通选择。”
defaultPrompts: Search rides from Waterloo Station to London Zoo
defaultPromptsZh: 搜索从 滑铁卢站 到 伦敦动物园 的行程

plugin_asdk_app_6a02fad225b08191a6b3728f.productIntroEn: EconomyBookings helps travelers easily search and compare rental cars worldwide. Find available vehicles by pickup location, travel dates, driver age, and preferences like car category, transmission type, supplier, model, and total rental price, all through natural conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a02fad225b08191a6b3728f.longDescription:
EconomyBookings helps travelers easily search and compare rental cars worldwide. Find available vehicles by pickup location, travel dates, driver age, and preferences like car category, transmission type, supplier, model, and total rental price, all through natural conversation.

What you can do:

- Search for rental cars by city, airport, or pickup location
- Filter results by vehicle type, transmission, supplier, price range, fuel policy, and more
- Compare car hire options with pricing, supplier ratings, included features, and rental conditions
- Browse vehicle details including luggage capacity, passenger limits, and transmission type
- Get direct booking links to continue your reservation with EconomyBookings.

Results include trusted rental suppliers, transparent pricing, and key rental terms to help you compare options confidently before booking.
plugin_asdk_app_6a02fad225b08191a6b3728f.longDescriptionZh:
EconomyBookings 可帮助旅行者轻松搜索和比较全球租车。通过自然对话，通过取车地点、旅行日期、驾驶员年龄以及汽车类别、变速箱类型、供应商、型号和总租赁价格等偏好来查找可用车辆。

你可以做什么：

- 按城市、机场或取车地点搜索租车
- 按车辆类型、变速箱、供应商、价格范围、燃油政策等筛选结果
- 将汽车租赁选项与定价、供应商评级、包含的功能和租赁条件进行比较
- 浏览车辆详细信息，包括行李容量、乘客限制和变速箱类型
- 获取直接预订链接以继续通过 EconomyBookings 进行预订。

结果包括值得信赖的租赁供应商、透明的定价和关键租赁条款，可帮助您在预订前自信地比较选项。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2872ba07708191bff1c8c7.productIntro: Meow Map 搜索酒店、日式旅馆、宾馆和猫咪咖啡馆的精选数据库，客人在这些数据库中实际见过一只住在这里的猫。每个结果均来自提及真实猫的经过验证的客人评论。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2872ba07708191bff1c8c7.productIntroEn: Meow Map searches a curated database of hotels, ryokans, guesthouses, and cat cafés where guests have actually seen a resident cat on the property. Every result is sourced from verified guest reviews mentioning real cats.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2872ba07708191bff1c8c7.longDescription:
Meow Map searches a curated database of hotels, ryokans, guesthouses, and cat cafés where guests have actually seen a resident cat on the property. Every result is sourced from verified guest reviews mentioning real cats.

Search by city name or GPS coordinates. Results include the cat's name (when known), a summary of what guests said about it, and how recent the data is.

Useful for planning cat-themed travel itineraries, finding pet-adjacent accommodation, or just wanting to stay somewhere with a hotel cat.

All results can be explored on the full interactive map at meowmap.dev
plugin_asdk_app_6a2872ba07708191bff1c8c7.longDescriptionZh:
Meow Map 搜索酒店、日式旅馆、宾馆和猫咪咖啡馆的精选数据库，客人在这些数据库中实际见过一只住在这里的猫。每个结果均来自提及真实猫的经过验证的客人评论。

按城市名称或 GPS 坐标搜索。结果包括猫的名字（已知时）、客人对此的评价摘要以及数据的最新程度。

对于规划以猫为主题的旅行行程、寻找与宠物相邻的住宿，或者只是想与酒店的猫一起住在某个地方，非常有用。

plugin_asdk_app_694d544b38b88191b47f75df.longDescription:
Get an instant, upfront fare estimate and full trip details before you book.

What you can do:
• See the exact price for your route with no hidden fees
• Compare travel time for different routing options
• Check estimated time of arrival (ETA) and car arrival time
• Find the best pickup points to save time and money
• Go straight to booking – your estimate opens seamlessly in the Yango app to complete your ride securely

Yango uses live traffic data and smart routing to provide accurate, real‑time trip planning.

• 检查预计到达时间 (ETA) 和汽车到达时间
• 找到最佳接送点以节省时间和金钱

Travel the World with 12Go

The 12Go ChatGPT app helps you find and compare travel options in seconds. Just type what you need, and we’ll handle the rest. We cover buses, ferries, flights, trains and more to solve all your travel needs.

plugin_asdk_app_6a434332b1cc81918d75188a.productIntro: eSIM Finder 可帮助旅行者查找和比较 190 多个国家和地区的预付费旅行 eSIM 数据计划 - 无需离开聊天室。告诉它您的目的地和行程长度，它就会搜索实时计划，比较数据流量和 40 种货币的价格，解释计划类型，并为您提供指向您选择的计划的链接。它还提供年度旅行通行证——一张可重复使用的纯数据 eSIM 卡，覆盖约 130 个国家/地区，有效期为 12 个月。
plugin_asdk_app_6a434332b1cc81918d75188a.productIntroEn: eSIM Finder helps travellers find and compare prepaid travel eSIM data plans for 190+ countries and regions — without leaving the chat. Tell it your destination and trip length and it searches live plans, compares data allowances and prices in 40 currencies, explains the plan types, and gives you a link to the plan you choose.
plugin_asdk_app_6a434332b1cc81918d75188a.longDescription: eSIM Finder helps travellers find and compare prepaid travel eSIM data plans for 190+ countries and regions — without leaving the chat. Tell it your destination and trip length and it searches live plans, compares data allowances and prices in 40 currencies, explains the plan types, and gives you a link to the plan you choose. It also offers an Annual Travel Pass — one reusable data-only eSIM covering ~130 countries for 12 months. The connector is read-only and anonymous: no account, no sign-up, and it never sees your name, email, or conversation history. Purchases are completed on the provider's secure store; eSIM Finder takes no payments.
plugin_asdk_app_6a434332b1cc81918d75188a.longDescriptionZh: eSIM Finder 可帮助旅行者查找和比较 190 多个国家和地区的预付费旅行 eSIM 数据计划 - 无需离开聊天室。告诉它您的目的地和行程长度，它就会搜索实时计划，比较数据流量和 40 种货币的价格，解释计划类型，并为您提供指向您选择的计划的链接。它还提供年度旅行通行证——一张可重复使用的纯数据 eSIM 卡，覆盖约 130 个国家/地区，有效期为 12 个月。该连接器是只读且匿名的：没有帐户，无需注册，并且永远不会看到您的姓名、电子邮件或对话历史记录。购买是在提供商的安全商店中完成的； eSIM Finder 不收取任何费用。

plugin_asdk_app_6945a0c33d448191bd121973.productIntro: 乘坐巴士或火车前往世界各地最简单的方式。
plugin_asdk_app_6945a0c33d448191bd121973.productIntroEn: The easiest way to travel by bus or train worldwide.
plugin_asdk_app_6945a0c33d448191bd121973.longDescription:
The easiest way to travel by bus or train worldwide.

Busbud helps you book tickets for routes from thousands of bus and train companies, so you can quickly find and book the option that fits you best.

With Busbud on ChatGPT, you can:
• Explore schedules from thousands of bus and train companies
• Get up-to-date prices, amenities and availability
• Find the cheapest or fastest trips for your journey
• See key details at a glance: company profile, price, duration, and departure times

Why travelers choose Busbud:

• Coverage across 80+ countries and millions of routes, with strong presence in North America, Latin America, Europe, and Africa
• Trusted bus carriers like Greyhound, FlixBus, ADO, ALSA, BlaBlaCar, Trailways, Intercape, and many regional operators
• Train operators including VIA Rail, Amtrak, SNCF, Eurostar, and Renfe
• Clear, competitive pricing across bus and train carriers
plugin_asdk_app_6945a0c33d448191bd121973.longDescriptionZh:
乘坐巴士或火车前往世界各地最简单的方式。

Busbud 帮助您预订数千家巴士和火车公司路线的车票，以便您可以快速找到并预订最适合您的选项。

通过 ChatGPT 上的 Busbud，您可以：
• 探索数千家巴士和火车公司的时刻表
• 获取最新价格、设施和供应情况
• 为您的旅程找到最便宜或最快的行程
• 关键详细信息一目了然：公司简介、价格、持续时间和出发时间

旅行者选择 Busbud 的原因：

• 覆盖80多个国家和数百万条航线，在北美、拉丁美洲、欧洲和非洲拥有强大影响力
• 值得信赖的巴士运营商，如 Greyhound、FlixBus、ADO、ALSA、BlaBlaCar、Trailways、Intercape 以及许多区域运营商
• 火车运营商包括 VIA Rail、Amtrak、SNCF、Eurostar 和 Renfe
• 巴士和火车运营商的清晰、有竞争力的定价

plugin_asdk_app_69610ef30e448191aed57cd6.productIntro: pickyourmatch 为旅行者找到确切的可预订住宿，而不是房间类别。每个单元都经过单独描述，包括景观、地板、床位以及每个单元的儿童和狗津贴，数据每晚从每个酒店的 GauVendi 系统更新。
plugin_asdk_app_69610ef30e448191aed57cd6.productIntroEn: pickyourmatch finds travellers the exact bookable accommodation — not a room category. Every unit is individually described down to the view, the floor, the beds and the per-unit child and dog allowance, with data refreshed nightly from each property's GauVendi system.
plugin_asdk_app_69610ef30e448191aed57cd6.longDescription:
pickyourmatch finds travellers the exact bookable accommodation — not a room category. Every unit is individually described down to the view, the floor, the beds and the per-unit child and dog allowance, with data refreshed nightly from each property's GauVendi system.

Ask for "an apartment in Schladming for 2 adults, 2 kids and a dog, 16–19 August" and the app returns units that are actually available for those dates, with the real nightly rate and a direct booking link that opens the property's own booking calendar with the exact unit and dates preselected — no portals, no middleman, no fees on top.

Also included: themed promotions and packages (dog holidays, romance, wellness, culinary) with included extras, searchable by city or theme. The app is read-only, needs no account and processes no personal data.
plugin_asdk_app_69610ef30e448191aed57cd6.longDescriptionZh:
pickyourmatch 为旅行者找到确切的可预订住宿，而不是房间类别。每个单元都经过单独描述，包括景观、地板、床位以及每个单元的儿童和狗津贴，数据每晚从每个酒店的 GauVendi 系统更新。

如果您询问“8 月 16 日至 19 日在斯拉德明入住的一套公寓，适合 2 名成人、2 名儿童和一只狗”，该应用程序会返回这些日期实际可用的单元，并附有真实的每晚房价和直接预订链接，可打开酒店自己的预订日历，其中包含预先选定的确切单元和日期 — 没有门户，没有中间商，不收取任何费用。

还包括：主题促销和套餐（狗假期、浪漫、健康、烹饪），包含额外内容，可按城市或主题搜索。该应用程序是只读的，不需要帐户，也不处理任何个人数据。

Find me a room with a panoramic view on a high floor — and show me exactly which room I'd get
defaultPromptsZh: 计划和我们的狗一起在山里度过一个漫长的周末——一个舒适的地方，有美味的食物

Users can search for tours, attraction tickets, WiFi or eSIM connectivity, SIM cards, portable WiFi, and food experiences by describing their destination and what they are looking for.

plugin_asdk_app_6a200e742bb48191bf0d78b7.name: Novasol
plugin_asdk_app_6a200e742bb48191bf0d78b7.productIntro: NOVASOL 帮助旅行者发现欧洲各地的度假屋、度假公寓和度假目的地。
plugin_asdk_app_6a200e742bb48191bf0d78b7.productIntroEn: NOVASOL helps travelers discover holiday homes, holiday apartments, and vacation destinations across Europe.
plugin_asdk_app_6a200e742bb48191bf0d78b7.longDescription:
NOVASOL helps travelers discover holiday homes, holiday apartments, and vacation destinations across Europe. 

Search thousands of bookable holiday properties across 18 European countries, all within a conversation. 

Tell ChatGPT where you want to go, when, how many guests, your budget, and any must-have features, and it will surface a ranked carousel of matching homes with names, locations, prices, review scores, bedroom counts, and pet policies. Refine on the fly: change dates, shift your destination, tighten your budget, or add amenities and the results update instantly. Standout properties are highlighted so you can go straight to the card to see photos, full amenity lists, and booking options. This app covers self-catering holiday rental search only. It does not cover hotels, flights, car hire, package holidays, city apartments for short-term urban stays, aggregate price statistics, or any booking or payment action.
plugin_asdk_app_6a200e742bb48191bf0d78b7.longDescriptionZh:
NOVASOL 帮助旅行者发现欧洲各地的度假屋、度假公寓和度假目的地。 

在对话中搜索 18 个欧洲国家的数千个可预订度假酒店。 

告诉 ChatGPT 您想去哪里、什么时候、有多少客人、您的预算以及任何必备功能，它就会显示一个排名轮播的匹配房屋，其中包括名称、位置、价格、评论分数、卧室数量和宠物政策。即时优化：更改日期、改变目的地、收紧预算或添加便利设施，结果会立即更新。突出显示了杰出的酒店，因此您可以直接转到卡片查看照片、完整的设施列表和预订选项。该应用程序仅涵盖自助式度假租赁搜索。它不包括酒店、航班、汽车租赁、度假套餐、短期城市住宿的城市公寓、总价格统计或任何预订或付款操作。

plugin_asdk_app_69f076da6cb881918619a90d.productIntro: HelloSafe 旅行保险比较器可帮助您直接在 ChatGPT 对话中查找并比较来自许可提供商的旅行保险计划。 输入您的目的地、旅行日期和旅行者详细信息，以接收个性化报价以及并排显示的承保信息。 该应用程序支持多个国家/地区、语言和货币，无论您来自何处，都可以轻松比较选项。 无论您需要医疗保险、申根签证保险、旅行取消保护还是年度多次旅行计划，HelloSafe 都能帮助您快速找到合适的选择。
plugin_asdk_app_69f076da6cb881918619a90d.productIntroEn: HelloSafe Travel Insurance Comparator helps you find and compare travel insurance plans from licensed providers, directly within your ChatGPT conversation. plugin_asdk_app_69f076da6cb881918619a90d.longDescription:
HelloSafe Travel Insurance Comparator helps you find and compare travel insurance plans from licensed providers, directly within your ChatGPT conversation.
Enter your destination, travel dates, and traveler details to receive personalized quotes with coverage information displayed side by side.
The app supports multiple countries, languages, and currencies, making it easy to compare options wherever you are traveling from.
Whether you need medical coverage, Schengen visa-compliant insurance, trip cancellation protection, or annual multi-trip plans, HelloSafe helps you quickly identify suitable options.
You can then continue on the HelloSafe website to view full details, refine your selection, and complete your purchase.

plugin_asdk_app_69849432c7e88191b025ef56.name: Headout
plugin_asdk_app_69849432c7e88191b025ef56.productIntro: Headout 可帮助您发现旅行时可以做的事情。
plugin_asdk_app_69849432c7e88191b025ef56.productIntroEn: Headout helps you discover things to do when you travel.
plugin_asdk_app_69849432c7e88191b025ef56.longDescription:
Headout helps you discover things to do when you travel.

Use natural language to explore tours, attractions, and activities across cities around the world. Search by destination, interest, traveler type, or specific landmarks to find experiences that match what you’re looking for.

With Headout, you can:
- Discover experiences in cities worldwide
- Explore activities linked to popular attractions and landmarks
- Find ideas for families, couples, solo travelers, and more
- Refine results through follow-up questions without restarting your search

This app focuses on discovery and planning. It helps you explore options, compare experiences, and decide what to do before booking.

Whether you have a specific place in mind or just want ideas, Headout makes it easy to explore what’s possible.
plugin_asdk_app_69849432c7e88191b025ef56.longDescriptionZh:
Headout 可帮助您发现旅行时可以做的事情。

使用自然语言探索世界各地城市的旅游、景点和活动。按目的地、兴趣、旅行者类型或特定地标进行搜索，找到符合您需求的体验。

通过 Headout，您可以：
- 探索世界各地城市的体验
- 探索与热门景点和地标相关的活动
- 为家庭、情侣、独行旅行者等寻找创意
- 通过后续问题优化结果，无需重新启动搜索

这个应用程序专注于发现和规划。它可以帮助您在预订前探索选择、比较体验并决定要做什么。

无论您有一个特定的想法还是只是想要一些想法，Headout 都可以让您轻松探索可能性。
defaultPrompts: Show top experiences in London
defaultPromptsZh: 显示伦敦的顶级体验

plugin_asdk_app_69a957610170819189c91507.longDescription:
A FINN car subscription is a flexible way to stay mobile anytime - without long-term commitments like buying or leasing a car. With a fixed monthly rate that already includes insurance, maintenance, registration, and even CO₂ offsetting, the car subscription offers full transparency and convenience.

Best of all, you can book online in just a few minutes, and your new car will be delivered straight to your doorstep or you can pick it up at one of our stations.

plugin_asdk_app_6a21a9cfb3708191862647bb.productIntroEn: Road Trip Planner helps you find campgrounds that fit the way you travel. Ask for RV parks near a national park, pet-friendly tent sites, cabins with air conditioning, or family-friendly campgrounds with showers, playgrounds, WiFi, and dog parks.
plugin_asdk_app_6a21a9cfb3708191862647bb.longDescription:
Road Trip Planner helps you find campgrounds that fit the way you travel. Ask for RV parks near a national park, pet-friendly tent sites, cabins with air conditioning, or family-friendly campgrounds with showers, playgrounds, WiFi, and dog parks.

Search by destination, nearby coordinates, camping style, and amenities, then compare practical details like location, site count, rules, campground maps when available, and direct booking links from Park With Us. Discover your next great meal with FunNow. Whether you are planning a special event or need a table right now, FunNow makes it easy to find and book restaurants tailored to your specific needs across Asia's top culinary destinations.

What you can do with FunNow:
- Explore & Book Across Asia: Seamlessly search and secure restaurant reservations in major cities throughout Taiwan, Japan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, and the Philippines.
- Last-Minute Tables & Exclusive Discounts: Perfect for impromptu plans. FunNow specializes in real-time availability, allowing you to make last-minute bookings while instantly accessing discounts and special offers.
- Personalized Recommendations: Skip the endless scrolling. Simply input your current location, preferred tastes, and the occasion—whether it is a romantic date, a business lunch, or a casual night out—and receive a curated list of top options to help you decide.

Spend less time searching and more time enjoying your meal. Let FunNow connect you to the perfect dining experience, exactly when and where you need it.

plugin_asdk_app_69e9c67943c08191a37c464b.name: TrailVerse
plugin_asdk_app_69e9c67943c08191a37c464b.productIntro: TrailVerse 将国家公园探索带入 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_69e9c67943c08191a37c464b.productIntroEn: TrailVerse brings national parks exploration into ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69e9c67943c08191a37c464b.longDescription:
TrailVerse brings national parks exploration into ChatGPT.

Live data for 470+ U.S. national parks, monuments, and historic sites — plus day-by-day trip planning. Tell Trailie you’re a beginner with kids visiting Zion in July, and it can build a pace-matched itinerary using live NPS alerts and weather, with hike limits and family-friendly pacing when you ask. Always confirm safety-critical details on NPS.gov before you go.

Five focused capabilities:

• Plan a trip — Constraint-aware day-by-day itineraries (dates, hike difficulty/distance, pace). Revise the plan in the same chat. Best for NPS parks; also useful for broader U.S. trip ideas.

• Park details — Live weather, alerts, entrance fees, and top activities for NPS sites.

• Compare parks — Side-by-side 2–4 NPS parks with clear highlights.

• Search parks — Find NPS sites by state, activity, or name across the full catalog.

• Find events — Upcoming ranger programs, guided tours, and park-hosted events.

Read tools use the National Park Service API and live weather. Campground and permit inventory are not guaranteed live — confirm on Recreation.gov or NPS before booking. Free to use in ChatGPT. For saved trips, PDF export, and full Trailie history, continue at nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai.
plugin_asdk_app_69e9c67943c08191a37c464b.longDescriptionZh:
TrailVerse 将国家公园探索带入 ChatGPT。

470 多个美国国家公园、纪念碑和历史古迹的实时数据 - 以及每日旅行计划。告诉 Trailie，您是一位带着孩子在 7 月访问锡安的初学者，它可以使用实时 NPS 警报和天气来制定适合节奏的行程，并根据您的要求提供徒步限制和适合家庭的节奏。出发前请务必在 NPS.gov 上确认安全关键详细信息。

五项重点能力：

• 计划旅行——了解限制因素的每日行程（日期、徒步难度/距离、步速）。在同一次聊天中修改计划。最适合 NPS 公园；对于更广泛的美国旅行想法也很有用。

• 公园详细信息— NPS 站点的实时天气、警报、入场费和热门活动。

• 比较公园——并排列出2-4 个具有明显亮点的NPS 公园。

• 搜索公园— 在整个目录中按州、活动或名称查找NPS 站点。

• 查找活动— 即将推出的护林员计划、导游和公园举办的活动。

阅读工具使用国家公园服务 API 和实时天气。露营地和许可证库存不保证实时 - 预订前请在 Recreation.gov 或 NPS 上确认。可在 ChatGPT 中免费使用。如需保存的行程、PDF 导出和完整的 Trailie 历史记录，请继续访问Nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai。

plugin_asdk_app_69a97ec87f588191b8e25181.name: WeatherPromise
plugin_asdk_app_69a97ec87f588191b8e25181.productIntro: 使用 WeatherPromise 保护您的旅行，如果假期期间降雨量超过承诺的量，则自动收回全额费用。 告诉我们您的目的地、旅行日期和旅行费用，我们将向您展示针对您的旅行个性化的优惠。一旦您购买了该优惠，您的旅行将受到保护。 您将获得指向个人仪表板的链接，您可以在其中监控旅行期间的天气。降雨量是使用来自 NASA 和 NOAA 等官方来源的独立、准确的数据来测量的。 如果降雨量超过指定阈值，我们会自动向您发送电子邮件。
plugin_asdk_app_69a97ec87f588191b8e25181.productIntroEn: Protect your trip with WeatherPromise and get back the full cost if it rains more than promised during your vacation, automatically. Tell us your destination, travel dates and trip cost and we'll show you an offer, personalized to your trip. Once you purchase the offer, your trip is protected.
plugin_asdk_app_69a97ec87f588191b8e25181.longDescription:
Protect your trip with WeatherPromise and get back the full cost if it rains more than promised during your vacation, automatically.
Tell us your destination, travel dates and trip cost and we'll show you an offer, personalized to your trip. Once you purchase the offer, your trip is protected.
You will get a link to your personal dashboard where you can monitor the weather during your trip. Rain is measured using independent, accurate data from official sources like NASA and NOAA.
If it rains more than the specified threshold, we'll email you automatically. Just confirm your details and the payment is sent right away, no additional proof required.
Go on your trip and if it rains more than promised, you get a full refund, automatically.
plugin_asdk_app_69a97ec87f588191b8e25181.longDescriptionZh:
使用 WeatherPromise 保护您的旅行，如果假期期间降雨量超过承诺的量，则自动收回全额费用。
告诉我们您的目的地、旅行日期和旅行费用，我们将向您展示针对您的旅行个性化的优惠。一旦您购买了该优惠，您的旅行将受到保护。
您将获得指向个人仪表板的链接，您可以在其中监控旅行期间的天气。降雨量是使用来自 NASA 和 NOAA 等官方来源的独立、准确的数据来测量的。
如果降雨量超过指定阈值，我们会自动向您发送电子邮件。只需确认您的详细信息，付款就会立即发送，无需额外证明。
继续您的旅行，如果降雨量超过承诺的范围，您将自动获得全额退款。

Search and book 160+ hotels from Barceló Hotel Group across Spain, the Caribbean, Mexico, and more. Check real-time room availability and pricing, get detailed hotel information including amenities and policies, and generate direct booking links — all through natural conversation.

Covers Barceló Hotels & Resorts, Occidental Hotels & Resorts, Royal Hideaway, and Allegro brands. Supports multiple currencies and languages.

plugin_asdk_app_69fc5bf0562c8191b2c7dda4.productIntro: TripO 可让您在 ChatGPT 内预订全球酒店 - 与大多数预订网站不同，您无需为此付出任何代价。 预订时添加您的忠诚会员资格，您就可以保留您所赚取的一切：积分、精英身份认可、会员福利 - 所有这些都将享受到，就像您直接通过 IHG、万豪、希尔顿和其他主要连锁酒店预订一样。 在精选的豪华和商务酒店，TripO 更进一步。我们的优惠房价附带额外福利，例如免费早餐、客房升级（如有）、酒店积分以及提前入住或延迟退房——这些福利通常为高端旅行顾问保留。
plugin_asdk_app_69fc5bf0562c8191b2c7dda4.productIntroEn: TripO lets you book hotels worldwide right inside ChatGPT — and unlike most booking sites, you don't give anything up to do it. Add your loyalty membership when you book, and you keep what you've earned: points, elite status recognition, member benefits — all honored just as if you booked direct with IHG, Marriott, Hilton, and other major chains.
plugin_asdk_app_69fc5bf0562c8191b2c7dda4.longDescription:
TripO lets you book hotels worldwide right inside ChatGPT — and unlike most booking sites, you don't give anything up to do it.
Add your loyalty membership when you book, and you keep what you've earned: points, elite status recognition, member benefits — all honored just as if you booked direct with IHG, Marriott, Hilton, and other major chains.
At select luxury and business hotels, TripO goes further. Our preferred rates come with extra benefits like complimentary breakfast, room upgrades when available, hotel credits, and early check-in or late check-out — perks normally reserved for high-end travel advisors.
Just describe what you need in plain language — "a hotel near Shinjuku Station next weekend, breakfast included, under $150 a night" — and TripO returns live availability and real rates from professional travel inventory. Compare room types, bed configurations, and cancellation policies, refine conversationally, and book without ever leaving the chat.
TripO is built by FreeTravel, a travel technology company connecting AI assistants with global hotel inventory.
plugin_asdk_app_69fc5bf0562c8191b2c7dda4.longDescriptionZh:
TripO 可让您在 ChatGPT 内预订全球酒店 - 与大多数预订网站不同，您无需为此付出任何代价。
预订时添加您的忠诚会员资格，您就可以保留您所赚取的一切：积分、精英身份认可、会员福利 - 所有这些都将享受到，就像您直接通过 IHG、万豪、希尔顿和其他主要连锁酒店预订一样。
在精选的豪华和商务酒店，TripO 更进一步。我们的优惠房价附带额外福利，例如免费早餐、客房升级（如有）、酒店积分以及提前入住或延迟退房——这些福利通常为高端旅行顾问保留。
只需用简单的语言描述您的需求 - “下周末新宿站附近的酒店，含早餐，每晚 150 美元以下” - TripO 就会从专业旅游库存中返回实时空房情况和实际价格。比较房间类型、床型配置和取消政策，通过对话进行完善，无需离开聊天即可预订。
TripO 由 FreeTravel 打造，FreeTravel 是一家将人工智能助手与全球酒店库存连接起来的旅游科技公司。

plugin_asdk_app_69aa22f66d8c819199e8cb19.productIntroEn: Amapas Vacation Rental helps you explore and reserve a 2-bedroom ocean-view condo in Puerto Vallarta's Zona Romántica, one block from Los Muertos Beach.
plugin_asdk_app_69aa22f66d8c819199e8cb19.longDescription:
Amapas Vacation Rental helps you explore and reserve a 2-bedroom ocean-view condo in Puerto Vallarta's Zona Romántica, one block from Los Muertos Beach.

View the property details, check stay dates, see itemized pricing with taxes and fees, and submit a reservation request directly from the booking widget:

• Property details for the Amapas 353 condo
• Real-time pricing and availability
• Transparent price breakdown including taxes and cleaning fees
• Reservation request submission
• Email confirmation once your request is received

Located steps from Los Muertos beach above Mantamar and Almar Resort, Amapas 353 offers ocean views, rooftop infinity pool access, gym facilities, and easy access to the restaurants and nightlife of Zona Romántica.

Note: Payment is not collected inside ChatGPT. After your request is submitted, the property owner confirms availability and sends a secure payment link by email.
plugin_asdk_app_69aa22f66d8c819199e8cb19.longDescriptionZh:
Amapas Vacation Rental 可帮助您探索并预订位于巴亚尔塔港浪漫区 (Zona Romántica) 的两卧室海景公寓，距离 Los Muertos 海滩仅一个街区。

查看酒店详细信息，检查入住日期，查看含税费的明细价格，并直接从预订小部件提交预订请求：

• Amapas 353 公寓的房产详细信息
• 实时定价和供货情况
• 透明的价格明细，包括税费和清洁费
• 提交预订请求
• 收到您的请求后通过电子邮件确认

Amapas 353 位于 Mantamar 和 Almar Resort 度假村上方，距离 Los Muertos 海滩仅几步之遥，享有海景，可使用屋顶无边泳池和健身设施，并可轻松前往 Zona Romántica 的餐厅和夜生活场所。

注意：ChatGPT 内不收取付款。提交请求后，业主会确认空房情况并通过电子邮件发送安全付款链接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a06e24abdb48191a94eeebb.name: Eurostars Hotel Company
plugin_asdk_app_6a06e24abdb48191a94eeebb.productIntro: 在几分钟内计划您的下一次旅行。
plugin_asdk_app_6a06e24abdb48191a94eeebb.productIntroEn: Plan your next trip in minutes.
plugin_asdk_app_6a06e24abdb48191a94eeebb.longDescription:
Plan your next trip in minutes.

With the Eurostars Hotel Company app, you can discover hotels that suit you and book quickly and easily, without wasting time.

Choose a brand for every type of trip: Eurostars Hotels for city breaks, Áurea Hotels for boutique experiences, Dorma Hotels for leisure getaways, Exe Hotels for business trips, Ikonik Hotels for short city stays, Crisol Hotels for practical and affordable options, and Tandem Suites for apartments ideal for families or longer stays.

Just tell ChatGPT your destination, dates, and budget. Add your must-haves: area, breakfast, parking, spa, gym, or room type, and the app will recommend available hotels, refining the results with follow-up questions to get even closer to what you need.

Ask for what you want:
• “Romantic hotels in Seville with a spa for this weekend”
• “A centrally located hotel for 4 people in Valencia”
• “Availability tonight for under €150 in Barcelona”

Ready to travel? Click on the option you like best and complete your booking on the Eurostars website, without losing the thread.

在几分钟内计划您的下一次旅行。

借助 Eurostars Hotel Company 应用程序，您可以发现适合您的酒店并快速轻松地预订，无需浪费时间。

为每种类型的旅行选择一个品牌：适合城市度假的 Eurostars Hotels、适合精品体验的 Áurea Hotels、适合休闲度假的 Dorma Hotels、适合商务旅行的 Exe Hotels、适合短期城市住宿的 Ikonik Hotels、适合实用且价格实惠的 Crisol Hotels，以及适合家庭或长期住宿的 Tandem Suites。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 您的目的地、日期和预算即可。添加您的必备条件：区域、早餐、停车位、水疗中心、健身房或房间类型，应用程序将推荐可用的酒店，并通过后续问题完善结果，以更接近您的需求。

询问您想要什么：
•“塞维利亚的浪漫酒店，周末还有水疗中心”
• “位于巴伦西亚市中心的酒店，可供 4 人入住”
•“今晚在巴塞罗那的价格低于 150 欧元”

准备好去旅行了吗？单击您最喜欢的选项，然后在欧洲之星网站上完成预订，而不会丢失线索。

plugin_asdk_app_6a01b173694081918b9aa255.longDescription:
Hotel Emperador Madrid Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Hotel Emperador Madrid, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Hotel Emperador Madrid?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

plugin_asdk_app_699f271413c88191bcd187a1.productIntroEn: Search for hotels equipped with Valpas patented bed bug prevention technology. Every hotel in our results is Valpas-certified, so you can travel with confidence knowing your accommodation prioritises hygiene, cleanliness, and guest safety.
plugin_asdk_app_699f271413c88191bcd187a1.longDescription:
Search for hotels equipped with Valpas patented bed bug prevention technology.  Every hotel in our results is Valpas-certified, so you can travel with confidence knowing your accommodation prioritises hygiene, cleanliness, and guest safety.

What you can do:
  - Search for Valpas-protected hotels by city, neighbourhood, price, and style
  - Browse detailed hotel information including photos, amenities, ratings, and guest reviews
  - Get direct booking links to reserve your room

Whether you're planning a leisure trip, a business stay, or managing travel for a group, simply describe what you're looking for - "Find a boutique hotel in Paris with great reviews" or "Show me safe, clean hotels in Berlin near the city center" - and Valpas will recommend verified properties that match.

All results are limited to hotels using Valpas anti-bed-bug technology. If no protected hotels match your exact criteria, the app will let you know and suggest adjusting your filters.
plugin_asdk_app_699f271413c88191bcd187a1.longDescriptionZh:
搜索配备 Valpas 专利臭虫预防技术的酒店。  我们搜索结果中的每家酒店均经过瓦尔帕斯认证，因此您可以放心旅行，因为您知道您的住宿优先考虑卫生、清洁和客人安全。

你可以做什么：
  - 按城市、街区、价格和风格搜索受瓦尔帕斯保护的酒店
  - 浏览详细的酒店信息，包括照片、设施、评级和住客评论

plugin_asdk_app_6a5297b02238819181fa2470.name: Stockholm Archipelago Trail
plugin_asdk_app_6a5297b02238819181fa2470.description: 规划徒步旅行和渡轮路线
plugin_asdk_app_6a5297b02238819181fa2470.productIntro: 斯德哥尔摩群岛步道应用程序将瑞典 270 公里的岛屿远足步道引入 ChatGPT。询问这条步道的约 20 个岛屿赛段（从北部的 Arholma 到南部的 Landsort）中的任何一个，并获取结构化的最新详细信息：距离、难度、港口和码头，以及咖啡馆、观景点、游泳点和避难所等景点。岛上各个舞台由公共渡轮连接，因此您可以规划步行和乘船相结合的路线。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5297b02238819181fa2470.productIntroEn: The Stockholm Archipelago Trail app brings Sweden's 270 km island hiking trail into ChatGPT. Ask about any of the trail's ~20 island stages — from Arholma in the north to Landsort in the south — and get structured, up-to-date details: distance, difficulty, harbours and piers, and points of interest such as cafés, viewpoints, swimming spots, and shelters.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5297b02238819181fa2470.longDescription:
The Stockholm Archipelago Trail app brings Sweden's 270 km island hiking trail into ChatGPT. Ask about any of the trail's ~20 island stages — from Arholma in the north to Landsort in the south — and get structured, up-to-date details: distance, difficulty, harbours and piers, and points of interest such as cafés, viewpoints, swimming spots, and shelters. The island stages are linked by public ferries, so you can plan routes that combine walking and boats.

Ask ChatGPT to show any stage on an interactive map, compare stages for a day trip or a multi-day hike, or pull practical details for the sections you're planning. All trail data is open (CC-BY-4.0) and read-only — the app stores no personal data. Place data comes from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata; the trail route is published by the Stockholm Archipelago Trail under CC-BY-4.0.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5297b02238819181fa2470.longDescriptionZh:
斯德哥尔摩群岛步道应用程序将瑞典 270 公里的岛屿远足步道引入 ChatGPT。询问这条步道的约 20 个岛屿赛段（从北部的 Arholma 到南部的 Landsort）中的任何一个，并获取结构化的最新详细信息：距离、难度、港口和码头，以及咖啡馆、观景点、游泳点和避难所等景点。岛上各个舞台由公共渡轮连接，因此您可以规划步行和乘船相结合的路线。

要求 ChatGPT 在交互式地图上显示任何阶段，比较一日游或多日徒步旅行的阶段，或者提取您计划的路段的实用详细信息。所有轨迹数据都是开放的 (CC-BY-4.0) 和只读 — 该应用程序不存储个人数据。地点数据来自 OpenStreetMap 和 Wikidata；该步道路线由斯德哥尔摩群岛步道以 CC-BY-4.0 名义发布。

在地图上显示阿霍玛舞台。

plugin_asdk_app_6967cdc847648191a549d9f6.name: Alpy.com
plugin_asdk_app_6967cdc847648191a549d9f6.description: 地球上最好的滑雪装备租赁
plugin_asdk_app_6967cdc847648191a549d9f6.productIntro: 穿越阿尔卑斯山的滑雪装备租赁变得简单。
plugin_asdk_app_6967cdc847648191a549d9f6.productIntroEn: Ski rentals across the Alps, made simple.
plugin_asdk_app_6967cdc847648191a549d9f6.longDescription:
Ski rentals across the Alps, made simple.

The Alpy.com ChatGPT app helps you find, compare, and rent ski and snowboard from shops across Europe—especially the Alps—without bouncing between tabs.

Try requests like:
	•	“Find ski rentals in Chamonix for Feb 10–15 for an intermediate skier.”
	•	“I need a kids helmet + boots package in Val Thorens, pickup 8:00 AM.”
	•	“Show me the best-value snowboard rental in Zermatt near the gondola.”

You’ll get relevant options with key details like equipment type, dates, pickup location, and price. Found the right fit? Tap through to Alpy.com to review details and complete your booking.
plugin_asdk_app_6967cdc847648191a549d9f6.longDescriptionZh:
穿越阿尔卑斯山的滑雪装备租赁变得简单。

Alpy.com ChatGPT 应用程序可帮助您查找、比较和租赁欧洲各地（尤其是阿尔卑斯山）商店的滑雪装备和滑雪板，而无需在选项卡之间切换。

尝试请求如下：
	• “为中级滑雪者查找 2 月 10 日至 15 日在霞慕尼的滑雪装备租赁服务。”
	• “我需要在 Val Thorens 购买儿童头盔 + 靴子套装，上午 8:00 取货。”
	• “向我展示采尔马特缆车附近最超值的滑雪板租赁服务。”

您将获得包含设备类型、日期、取货地点和价格等关键详细信息的相关选项。找到合适的人了吗？点击 Alpy.com 查看详细信息并完成预订。
defaultPrompts: I go skiing next week from Saturday to Friday to Solden
defaultPromptsZh: 我下周从周六到周五去索尔登滑雪

plugin_asdk_app_69d722ba3768819192200e6f.name: TravelSearch.io
plugin_asdk_app_69d722ba3768819192200e6f.productIntro: Travelsearch 是一种结构化的旅行搜索和发现工具，可根据自然语言查询返回高度相关的假期选项。
plugin_asdk_app_69d722ba3768819192200e6f.productIntroEn: Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.
plugin_asdk_app_69d722ba3768819192200e6f.longDescription:
Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search
plugin_asdk_app_69d722ba3768819192200e6f.longDescriptionZh:
Travelsearch 是一种结构化的旅行搜索和发现工具，可根据自然语言查询返回高度相关的假期选项。

它使人工智能代理能够使用丰富的多源产品数据将用户意图（例如目的地、预算、日期、便利设施、旅行方式）与真实的、可预订的旅行库存相匹配。

用户可以用通俗易懂的语言描述他们的旅行，例如：

“伦敦的豪华酒店，设有水疗中心和停车场”
“西班牙适合家庭入住的海滩度假村，价格低于 2,000 英镑”
“全包加勒比蜜月直飞航班”
通过将用户意图映射到丰富的旅行属性和实时库存（价格、可用性、位置、设施、评级和图像）来生成推荐，返回结构化结果，包括： 
属性/假期名称， 
描述， 
配套设施、 
每个选项适合查询的明确理由，以及 
来自值得信赖的旅行提供商的直接预订链接。
AI 代理的关键功能：
将自然语言查询映射到我们数据集中的结构化旅行属性（目的地、持续时间、乘车基础、便利设施、价格范围、旅行者类型）
聚合酒店、套餐和度假村的多品牌旅游库存
返回排名一致、意图匹配的结果 
提供商业上可行的输出（书籍的深层链接）

数据质量和覆盖范围：
多品牌、多供应商产品提要（无抓取内容）
根据供应商数据定期更新定价和可用性等
标准化和丰富的属性以实现一致匹配

无需表格或过滤器，针对对话式搜索和人工智能驱动的旅行计划进行了优化。

何时使用此工具：
当用户搜索假期、酒店或旅行推荐时
当查询包含偏好时（预算、便利设施、旅行方式、团体类型）
当需要带有链接的可预订选项时
何时应对结果进行个性化或过滤以超出通用搜索范围
defaultPrompts: Best Hotel in London with free wifi
defaultPromptsZh: 伦敦最好的酒店，提供免费无线网络

plugin_asdk_app_6a5dd768024c8191ae301c9c.longDescription:
Kombo is Europe's multimodal travel comparison platform. Ask for a route and date, and Kombo compares train, bus and flight options across hundreds of European operators — SNCF Voyageurs, inOui, OUIGO, TER, Eurostar, Trenitalia, Italo, Frecciarossa, Renfe, Deutsche Bahn, SBB, SNCB, NS, Alsa, Flixbus, BlaBlaCar, easyJet, Air France, British Airways and more.

plugin_asdk_app_69c271c5d3a08191af952662.productIntroEn: Préparez vos trajets facilement et voyagez à petit prix en Train Grande Vitesse ou Train Classique vers plus de 70 destinations en France et en Belgique, avec des billets à partir de 10 € selon votre gare de départ.
plugin_asdk_app_69c271c5d3a08191af952662.longDescription:
Préparez vos trajets facilement et voyagez à petit prix en Train Grande Vitesse ou Train Classique vers plus de 70 destinations en France et en Belgique, avec des billets à partir de 10 € selon votre gare de départ.

Accédez aux tarifs et horaires en temps réel en indiquant simplement votre gare de départ, votre destination et vos dates de voyage dans l’application OUIGO via ChatGPT. Comparez et affinez votre recherche pour choisir le train qui correspond à votre budget et à vos critères.
Une fois votre train sélectionné, vous n'aurez plus qu'à finaliser votre réservation en toute simplicité sur le site ou l’application OUIGO.

Personnalisez ensuite votre voyage selon vos besoins grâce aux différentes offres OUIGO :
  - OUIGO Essentiel : une formule à la carte, à compléter avec des options (choix de la place, bagage  supplémentaire ou volumineux, vélo plié ou sous housse, option OUIGOFLEX…)
  - OUIGO Plus : une formule « all inclusive » incluant le choix de la place, un bagage supplémentaire ou volumineux, ainsi que les services OUIFI et OUIFUN
 - OUIGO Full : une formule flexible, disponible à l’achat jusqu’à 7 jours avant le départ, incluant tous les avantages OUIGO Plus ainsi que l’option OUIGOFLEX pour échanger votre billet sans frais
plugin_asdk_app_69c271c5d3a08191af952662.longDescriptionZh:
轻松准备您的旅程，乘坐高速列车或经典列车以低廉的价格前往法国和比利时的 70 多个目的地，票价从 10 欧元起，具体取决于出发车站。

只需通过 ChatGPT 在 OUIGO 应用程序中输入出发站、目的地和旅行日期即可获取实时票价和时刻表。比较并优化您的搜索，以选择符合您的预算和标准的火车。
选择列车后，您只需在 OUIGO 网站或应用程序上轻松完成预订即可。

然后，通过不同的 OUIGO 优惠，根据您的需求个性化您的旅行：
  - OUIGO Essential：点菜方案，可通过选项完成（空间选择、额外或大件行李、折叠或遮盖自行车、OUIGOFLEX 选项等）
  - OUIGO Plus：“全包”方案，包括座位选择、额外或大件行李以及 OUIFI 和 OUIFUN 服务
 - OUIGO Full：灵活套餐，可在出发前 7 天购买，包括所有 OUIGO Plus 优惠以及免费换票的 OUIGOFLEX 选项

inside ChatGPT.
