plugin_asdk_app_69edd634b04881918f20d1c9.productIntro: Tripuck 是一项航班元搜索和旅行规划服务。这个连接器 让您搜索实时航班价格，探索航线中最便宜的日子 月，浏览任意始发城市的热门目的地，并打开完整 任何结果的航段/行李详细信息 - 无需离开聊天即可完成所有操作。
plugin_asdk_app_69edd634b04881918f20d1c9.productIntroEn: Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_69edd634b04881918f20d1c9.longDescription:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

plugin_asdk_app_6a61258708f0819187068d75.name: Perigee Tides & Conditions
plugin_asdk_app_6a61258708f0819187068d75.productIntro: 近地点潮汐和状况帮助人们找到 NOAA 潮汐预报站，并检查近期沿海外出钓鱼、划船、划船、海滩搜寻、摄影和沿海生活检查的窗口。对于选定的站点、活动、当地日期和 7 天内的时间，它将可用的潮汐预测、NWS 风力预测、日光和月亮计算以及 NOAA 水观测结合到规划状态、建议窗口、置信度、原因、注意事项、新鲜度和提供商属性中。覆盖范围仅限于 NOAA CO-OPS 美国和地区潮汐预报站，数据可用性因站而异。
plugin_asdk_app_6a61258708f0819187068d75.productIntroEn: Perigee Tides & Conditions helps people find NOAA tide-prediction stations and check near-term coastal outing windows for fishing, boating, paddling, beachcombing, photography, and coastal-living checks.
plugin_asdk_app_6a61258708f0819187068d75.longDescription: Perigee Tides & Conditions helps people find NOAA tide-prediction stations and check near-term coastal outing windows for fishing, boating, paddling, beachcombing, photography, and coastal-living checks. For a selected station, activity, local date, and time within seven days, it combines available tide predictions, NWS wind forecasts, daylight and moon calculations, and NOAA water observations into a planning state, recommended window, confidence, reasons, cautions, freshness, and provider attribution. Coverage is limited to NOAA CO-OPS U.S. and territory tide-prediction stations, and data availability varies by station. It is a planning aid—not navigation, emergency guidance, a comprehensive weather forecast, route clearance, or a safety verdict.
plugin_asdk_app_6a61258708f0819187068d75.longDescriptionZh: 近地点潮汐和状况帮助人们找到 NOAA 潮汐预报站，并检查近期沿海外出钓鱼、划船、划船、海滩搜寻、摄影和沿海生活检查的窗口。对于选定的站点、活动、当地日期和 7 天内的时间，它将可用的潮汐预测、NWS 风力预测、日光和月亮计算以及 NOAA 水观测结合到规划状态、建议窗口、置信度、原因、注意事项、新鲜度和提供商属性中。覆盖范围仅限于 NOAA CO-OPS 美国和地区潮汐预报站，数据可用性因站而异。它是一种规划辅助工具，而不是导航、紧急指导、综合天气预报、路线清理或安全判决。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2674430fb48191a596b5e4.productIntro: 通过 WAUG 探索旅行体验。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2674430fb48191a596b5e4.longDescription:
Discover travel experiences with WAUG.

Tell WAUG where you're going, what you enjoy, or what you're planning for your trip, and get personalized recommendations for tours, attractions, tickets, transportation, and local experiences.
Browse curated options with pricing, reviews, and key travel information in one place. Whether you're building an itinerary or looking for something to do nearby, WAUG helps you find relevant experiences quickly.

When you find an option you're interested in, select "Book on WAUG" to see full details and complete your booking.

From theme parks and attractions to rail passes, airport transfers, guided tours, and local activities, WAUG helps travelers discover and book experiences around the world.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2674430fb48191a596b5e4.longDescriptionZh:
通过 WAUG 探索旅行体验。

告诉 WAUG 您要去哪里、您喜欢什么或您的旅行计划是什么，并获得有关旅游、景点、门票、交通和当地体验的个性化建议。
在一处浏览包含价格、评论和主要旅行信息的精选选项。无论您是在制定行程还是寻找附近的活动，WAUG 都可以帮助您快速找到相关体验。

当您找到感兴趣的选项时，请选择“在 WAUG 上预订”以查看完整详细信息并完成预订。

从主题公园和景点到铁路通票、机场接送、导游和当地活动，WAUG 帮助旅行者探索和预订世界各地的体验。

Plan my Tokyo trip and recommend the best attraction tickets.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7373c41e6c81919bdbafd2.productIntroEn: Discover Greece as it's meant to be experienced. Across sun-drenched coastlines in Crete, Corfu, Kos, Santorini and Rhodes, and vibrant city stays in Athens and Piraeus, Mitsis brings together five decades of genuine Greek hospitality with hotels and resorts built for every kind of traveler.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7373c41e6c81919bdbafd2.longDescription:
Discover Greece as it's meant to be experienced. Across sun-drenched coastlines in Crete, Corfu, Kos, Santorini and Rhodes, and vibrant city stays in Athens and Piraeus, Mitsis brings together five decades of genuine Greek hospitality with hotels and resorts built for every kind of traveler.

Ask us what you're looking for, and we'll point you in the right direction. Whether it's an all-inclusive family escape by the beach, a refined city hotel close to everything that matters, or a more elevated retreat designed around comfort and privacy, our four brands — Mitsis, Mitsis Selection, Canvas by Mitsis, and Mitsis N'U — each bring their own personality while sharing the same warmth, care, and Greek character.

Compare properties, check what each destination has to offer, and find the right fit for your next trip — all in a few simple messages. From a spontaneous weekend away to a long-planned island holiday, your journey with Mitsis starts here.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7373c41e6c81919bdbafd2.longDescriptionZh:
探索希腊，体验它的魅力。米特西斯横跨克里特岛、科孚岛、科斯岛、圣托里尼岛和罗德岛阳光普照的海岸线，以及雅典和比雷埃夫斯充满活力的城市住宿，将五十年来真正的希腊热情好客之道与为各类旅客打造的酒店和度假村融为一体。

询问我们您在寻找什么，我们将为您指明正确的方向。无论是海滩边的一价全包家庭度假胜地、靠近一切重要场所的精致城市酒店，还是围绕舒适和隐私而设计的更高层次的度假胜地，我们的四个品牌——Mitsis、Mitsis Selection、Canvas by Mitsis 和 Mitsis N'U——每个品牌都拥有自己的个性，同时拥有相同的温暖、关怀和希腊特色。

比较酒店、查看每个目的地所提供的服务，并找到适合您下次旅行的酒店 - 所有这些都只需几条简单的信息即可完成。从自发的周末度假到计划已久的海岛度假，您与 Mitsis 的旅程从这里开始。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4c0a6c662c81919a0195f2.longDescription:
Never get stranded underground again.

Get instant, real-time status updates for all Milan metro lines M1, M2, M3, M4, and M5. Whether there's a delay, a service disruption, or everything's running smoothly, this app gives you a clear and immediate picture before you step onto the platform.

Simply ask things like:
- Is the M2 running normally right now?
- Are there any disruptions on the Milan metro today?
- What's the status of all lines?

Perfect for daily commuters, tourists, and anyone navigating Milan's underground network. Stay informed, save time, and travel smarter.

Metro status data is sourced directly from public feed, so you're always getting information straight from the source.

This app is developed by an independent developer and is not an official ATM Milano product. Always verify critical travel information directly with ATM Milano or official sources before making travel decisions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4c0a6c662c81919a0195f2.longDescriptionZh:
再也不会被困在地下了。

获取所有米兰地铁线路 M1、M2、M3、M4 和 M5 的即时、实时状态更新。无论是出现延迟、服务中断还是一切运行顺利，该应用程序都会在您踏入平台之前为您提供清晰、即时的图片。

只需询问以下问题即可：
- M2现在运行正常吗？
- 今天米兰地铁有中断吗？
- 所有线路的状态如何？

非常适合日常通勤者、游客和任何乘坐米兰地铁网络的人。随时了解情况、节省时间并更明智地旅行。

Metro 状态数据直接来自公共源，因此您始终可以直接从源获取信息。

该应用程序由独立开发者开发，并非 ATM Milano 官方产品。在做出旅行决定之前，请务必直接通过 ATM Milano 或官方来源核实重要旅行信息。
defaultPrompts: are there any disruptions on the Milan metro today?
what's the status of all lines?

plugin_asdk_app_69bfb5defb8c8191afa28f70.productIntro: Bellhopt 帮助度假出租屋的客人请求住宿期间的礼宾服务。
plugin_asdk_app_69bfb5defb8c8191afa28f70.productIntroEn: Bellhopt helps vacation rental guests request concierge services for their stay.
plugin_asdk_app_69bfb5defb8c8191afa28f70.longDescription:
Bellhopt helps vacation rental guests request concierge services for their stay.

Guests can browse available services, choose what they need, add stay details, enter the property address, and submit a request for Bellhopt to review. Depending on the location and available services, requests may include pre-arrival groceries, private chef experiences, transportation, spa and massage, arrival setup, celebration setup, and custom stay needs.

Bellhopt is designed for travelers who want a smoother, more prepared vacation rental experience. It gives guests one simple place to request stay services instead of searching for local options or coordinating everything manually.

Submitting a request does not confirm a booking, payment, vendor assignment, host approval, or guaranteed availability. Bellhopt reviews each request and follows up with next steps.
plugin_asdk_app_69bfb5defb8c8191afa28f70.longDescriptionZh:
Bellhopt 帮助度假出租屋的客人请求住宿期间的礼宾服务。

客人可以浏览可用的服务，选择自己需要的服务，添加住宿详细信息，输入酒店地址，并向 Bellhopt 提交审核请求。根据地点和可用服务的不同，请求可能包括抵达前杂货、私人厨师体验、交通、水疗和按摩、抵达布置、庆典布置和定制住宿需求。

Bellhopt 专为想要更顺畅、准备更充分的度假租赁体验的旅行者而设计。它为客人提供了一个简单的地方来请求住宿服务，而无需搜索当地选项或手动协调一切。

提交请求并不确认预订、付款、供应商分配、房东批准或保证可用性。 Bellhopt 会审核每个请求并跟进后续步骤。

plugin_asdk_app_69fccc58e3088191a22cffe6.name: HemmaBo
plugin_asdk_app_69fccc58e3088191a22cffe6.productIntro: HemmaBo 可帮助您发现房东拥有的度假租赁网站，并以加密方式验证住宿优惠是否由房东真实签署。按地点和日期查找房东拥有的房屋，确认房东的度假租赁协议 (VRP) 签名，并在房东自己的网站上获取经过验证的报价摘要，其中包含直接与房东预订的链接。度假租赁协议是房东签署的住宿优惠的开放标准。任何交易（预订和支付）都直接在 ChatGPT 之外的主机上进行。 HemmaBo 是一个验证层：不是一个市场，并且不需要预订佣金。
plugin_asdk_app_69fccc58e3088191a22cffe6.productIntroEn: HemmaBo helps you discover host-owned vacation rental websites and cryptographically verify that a stay offer is genuinely signed by the host. Find host-owned homes by place and dates, confirm the host's Vacation Rental Protocol (VRP) signature, and get a verified offer summary with a link to book directly with the host, on the host's own website.
plugin_asdk_app_69fccc58e3088191a22cffe6.longDescription: HemmaBo helps you discover host-owned vacation rental websites and cryptographically verify that a stay offer is genuinely signed by the host. Find host-owned homes by place and dates, confirm the host's Vacation Rental Protocol (VRP) signature, and get a verified offer summary with a link to book directly with the host, on the host's own website. Vacation Rental Protocol is an open standard for host-signed stay offers. Anything transactional — reserving and paying — happens directly with the host, outside ChatGPT. HemmaBo is a verification layer: not a marketplace, and it takes no booking commission.

plugin_asdk_app_6a80877913308191bbd7ba0f.longDescription: Operated by mediaconstructor GmbH & Co. KG on behalf of PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH. Payment never happens in chat: reservations under EUR 200 are confirmed directly and paid at the hotel, and from EUR 200 the booking system issues a three-day offer which the guest confirms with a card on its own secure page. No PLAZA account and no sign-in required.

plugin_asdk_app_6a321b839b4081918f95971d.productIntro: 计划在澳大利亚各地进行房车旅行、露营或小屋旅行吗？
plugin_asdk_app_6a321b839b4081918f95971d.productIntroEn: Planning a caravan, camping, or cabin trip around Australia?
plugin_asdk_app_6a321b839b4081918f95971d.longDescription:
Planning a caravan, camping, or cabin trip around Australia?

Total Parks instantly connects you to the same systems the staff use at reception.

Total Parks can help you find holiday parks, caravan parks, and campgrounds by destination, features, room or site details, trip vibe, dates, guests, pets, and rig details, then check the real facts before you commit. 

Ask for parks near a place, options that look open for a travel window, powered or ensuite sites, accessible or spa cabins, whether a park welcomes dogs, if your caravan or motorhome will fit a site, or what a cabin actually includes - and get answers based on current Total Parks listing, capability, policy, and planning availability checks instead of guesswork. 

Every answer links back to totalparks.com.au, and when a stay looks like a good fit you'll get a booking link with your dates, guests, and pet or rig details already filled in.
plugin_asdk_app_6a321b839b4081918f95971d.longDescriptionZh:
计划在澳大利亚各地进行房车旅行、露营或小屋旅行吗？

Total Parks 会立即将您连接到接待处工作人员使用的相同系统。

Total Parks 可以帮助您按目的地、特色、房间或地点详细信息、旅行氛围、日期、客人、宠物和装备详细信息查找假日公园、房车公园和露营地，然后在决定之前检查真实情况。 

询问某个地点附近的公园、可提供旅行窗口的选项、供电或套间场地、无障碍小屋或水疗小屋、公园是否欢迎狗、您的大篷车或房车是否适合场地，或者小屋实际包括什么 - 并根据当前 Total Parks 列表、能力、政策和规划可用性检查而不是猜测来获得答案。 

每个答案都会链接回totalparks.com.au，当您觉得合适的住宿时，您会收到一个预订链接，其中包含您已填写的日期、客人以及宠物或装备详细信息。

The Houstonian app for ChatGPT makes it easy to learn about The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa in Houston, Texas. You can ask questions and quickly get helpful information about the hotel’s amenities, services, and general details—all within the conversation.

You can also check current room rates and availability without leaving ChatGPT. This makes it convenient for travelers, event planners, or anyone interested in the hotel to see up-to-date information while planning a visit.

plugin_asdk_app_69f8b721487c819186183b20.longDescription:
Search and book rooms across the 7 Ognissanti Hotels in Florence: Palazzina Fusi, Hotel Lombardia, Hotel Arcadia, Hotel Villa Betania, L'Antica Porta, Residenza Ognissanti, and        
  Novella's Apartment.                                                                                                                                                                    
                                         
  Ask in plain language ("a quiet double near the Duomo for two nights in May") and the app returns live availability with real prices, photos, and a direct booking link from our        
  reservation system. You can generate a personalized quotation on the spot.           
                                                                                                                                                                                          
  You can also browse Florence experiences from our partner Ciao Florence — skip-the-line Uffizi tours, Tuscan wine tastings, Vespa rentals, cooking classes, day trips to Pisa and Siena 
  — each with a direct booking link.     
                                                                                                                                                                                          
  No login required. Booking and payment happen through our HotelInCloud reservation system, not inside the chat.

  中篇小说的公寓。

  预订系统。您可以当场生成个性化报价。           
                                                                                                                                                                                          
  您还可以从我们的合作伙伴 Ciao Florence 浏览佛罗伦萨体验 - 免排队乌菲齐之旅、托斯卡纳品酒、摩托车租赁、烹饪课程、比萨和锡耶纳一日游

plugin_asdk_app_6a930fda28148191a2f5a7e1.name: VoyageHacks
plugin_asdk_app_6a930fda28148191a2f5a7e1.productIntro: VoyageHacks 为 ChatGPT 带来了一个多语言旅行图书馆：11 种语言的约 680 个经过事实核查的指南，涵盖航班、航空公司评论、酒店、目的地、汽车租赁、火车、机场接送、eSIM 和旅行装备。
plugin_asdk_app_6a930fda28148191a2f5a7e1.productIntroEn: VoyageHacks brings a multilingual travel library into ChatGPT: about 680 fact-checked guides in each of 11 languages, covering flights, airline reviews, hotels, destinations, car rental, trains, airport transfers, eSIM and travel gear.
plugin_asdk_app_6a930fda28148191a2f5a7e1.longDescription:
VoyageHacks brings a multilingual travel library into ChatGPT: about 680 fact-checked guides in each of 11 languages, covering flights, airline reviews, hotels, destinations, car rental, trains, airport transfers, eSIM and travel gear.

Ask a travel question and ChatGPT can search the library and quote it with a real source URL and a real last-updated date, instead of relying on training data that may be a year stale.

Ask what to pack for a specific trip and it builds a kit from the VoyageHacks travel gear catalog: roughly 320 products picked across about 50 published buying guides, one per category, each with the published reason it was chosen and a link to the guide that reviews it.

Every guide exists in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech, Japanese, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese, each written independently rather than machine-translated, so a reader gets sources in their own language.

All tools are read-only. The app returns published guides and product recommendations: it has no live fares or room rates, does not check availability, and cannot make a booking or take a payment. No account or sign-in is needed.

Some links are affiliate links. VoyageHacks may earn a commission from qualifying purchases at no additional cost to the user.
plugin_asdk_app_6a930fda28148191a2f5a7e1.longDescriptionZh:
VoyageHacks 为 ChatGPT 带来了一个多语言旅行图书馆：11 种语言的约 680 个经过事实核查的指南，涵盖航班、航空公司评论、酒店、目的地、汽车租赁、火车、机场接送、eSIM 和旅行装备。

提出旅行问题，ChatGPT 可以搜索库并使用真实的源 URL 和真实的上次更新日期引用它，而不是依赖可能已经过时一年的训练数据。

当询问一次特定旅行要携带什么物品时，它会从 VoyageHacks 旅行装备目录中构建一个套件：从约 50 个已发布的购买指南中挑选出约 320 种产品，每个类别一个，每个产品都有已发布的选择原因以及评论指南的链接。

每本指南都有英语、德语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语、波兰语、捷克语、日语、荷兰语、巴西葡萄牙语和简体中文版本，每个指南都是独立编写的，而不是机器翻译的，因此读者可以获得自己语言的资源。

所有工具都是只读的。该应用程序返回已发布的指南和产品推荐：它没有实时票价或房价，不会检查可用性，也无法进行预订或付款。无需帐户或登录。

有些链接是附属链接。 VoyageHacks 可以通过符合条件的购买赚取佣金，而无需用户支付额外费用。

Which power bank is still allowed on a plane in 2026?
Where should I stay in Rome on a budget, and why that area?

如果预算有限，我应该在罗马住在哪里？为什么选择那个地区？

plugin_asdk_app_6a81780cd2d08191896ba0a7.name: OPEN - what is open right now
plugin_asdk_app_6a81780cd2d08191896ba0a7.productIntro: OPEN 回答了一个问题：该业务现在是否营业以及营业时间。
plugin_asdk_app_6a81780cd2d08191896ba0a7.productIntroEn: OPEN answers one question: is this business open right now, and until when.
plugin_asdk_app_6a81780cd2d08191896ba0a7.longDescription:
OPEN answers one question: is this business open right now, and until when.

Opening hours tell you how a place usually is. OPEN tells you what is true at this moment, because the answer comes from the business owner, who updates it from their phone. A shop that closed early today says so. A place with no fresh information reads UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN is never presented as CLOSED.

Ask in plain language - "what is open near Machane Yehuda right now?", "find a coffee shop that stays open at least another hour" - and the answer arrives with an interactive map inside the conversation. Service professionals are covered too: plumbers, electricians, handymen and locksmiths report whether they are available for work right now.

Four read-only tools: open_now, search_businesses, get_business and list_categories. No sign-in, no writes, no personal data, no advertising.

Coverage: OPEN is in pilot in Jerusalem, Israel, and the catalogue grows through in-person recruitment of business owners. A query about another city will return little or nothing. Hebrew and English.
plugin_asdk_app_6a81780cd2d08191896ba0a7.longDescriptionZh:
OPEN 回答了一个问题：该业务现在是否营业以及营业时间。

开放时间可以告诉您一个地方通常的情况。 OPEN 会告诉您此时此刻的真实情况，因为答案来自企业主，他通过手机更新答案。一家今天提早关门的商店是这么说的。没有新信息的地方会显示“未知”，并且“未知”永远不会显示为“已关闭”。

用简单的语言询问 - “现在 Machane Yehuda 附近有什么店在营业？”、“找一家至少再营业一个小时的咖啡店” - 答案会在对话中通过交互式地图出现。服务专业人员也包括在内：水管工、电工、杂工和锁匠报告他们现在是否可以工作。

四个只读工具：open_now、search_businesses、get_business 和 list_categories。无需登录、无需写入、无需个人数据、无需广告。

覆盖范围：OPEN 在以色列耶路撒冷进行试点，目录通过亲自招募企业主来扩大。关于另一个城市的查询将返回很少或没有返回。希伯来语和英语。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7857ebf7c48191938b9913.productIntro: 土耳其公民（普通/勃艮第护照）签证申请的信息和计算工具。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7857ebf7c48191938b9913.productIntroEn: An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).
plugin_asdk_app_6a7857ebf7c48191938b9913.longDescription:
An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7857ebf7c48191938b9913.longDescriptionZh:
土耳其公民（普通/勃艮第护照）签证申请的信息和计算工具。

它回答诸如“我需要日本签证吗？”、“德国签证费用是多少？”等问题。和“我还剩多少申根天？” ——始终有其来源。

它涵盖的内容：

· 172 个国家的签证状态 — 55 个免签国家、23 个落地签证国家、30 个电子签证国家、64 个需要领事馆申请的国家
· 每个国家：费用、公布的处理时间、申请中心和所需文件
· 根据欧盟委员会统计数据（27 个国家），土耳其申根申请的拒绝率
· 拒绝上诉：七个申根国家的主管机关、截止日期、语言和费用，以及标准表格上所有 17 个拒绝理由的含义
· 计算器：申根 90/180 天津贴、多次入境（级联）资格以及按央行汇率计算的土耳其里拉总费用

数据收集方式：

每笔金额和持续时间均根据官方领事馆、部委或立法来源进行核实，并逐字引用。无法验证的值不会被发布——没有任何估计；该字段留空并称为空。答案带有来源和最后更新日期。

只有有关国家的领事馆才能签发签证。我们不是代理机构：我们不提交申请、预约或保证批准。

plugin_asdk_app_6a18144985b8819192969ce2.productIntro: Porcel酒店助手帮助客人通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见的预订任务。 用户可以询问有关波尔塞尔酒店的问题，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策和入住/退房时间。助理还可以检查房间可用性并列出可选的房间附加服务。 如果客人已经预订，助理可以检索预订详细信息，并在提供所需的预订信息后帮助修改或取消现有预订。 如果客人需要帮助，助理还可以帮助创建新的预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
plugin_asdk_app_6a18144985b8819192969ce2.productIntroEn: Porcel hotels Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat. Users can ask questions about Porcel hotels, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
plugin_asdk_app_6a18144985b8819192969ce2.longDescription:
Porcel hotels Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Porcel hotels, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Porcel hotels?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

Note: Some reservation actions may require providing booking details such as reservation code or guest information.
plugin_asdk_app_6a18144985b8819192969ce2.longDescriptionZh:
Porcel酒店助手帮助客人通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见的预订任务。
用户可以询问有关波尔塞尔酒店的问题，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策和入住/退房时间。助理还可以检查房间可用性并列出可选的房间附加服务。
如果客人已经预订，助理可以检索预订详细信息，并在提供所需的预订信息后帮助修改或取消现有预订。
如果客人需要帮助，助理还可以帮助创建新的预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
您可以提出的示例问题：
“何时可在波尔塞尔酒店办理入住？”
“下周末还有房间吗？”
“显示可用的房型。”
“修改我的预订日期。”
“取消我的预订。”
“请联系酒店以帮助我预订。”

注意：某些预订操作可能需要提供预订详细信息，例如预订代码或客人信息。

defaultPromptsZh: 我可以选择哪些波塞尔酒店？

plugin_asdk_app_6a61c7e71c948191bab9d249.productIntro: TravCozy 将您旅行的每个部分整合在一起。向 ChatGPT 询问您的旅行，它会根据您的真实预订（从任何预订网站导入的航班、酒店、火车、汽车租赁和接送服务）进行回答，并组织成每日行程。
plugin_asdk_app_6a61c7e71c948191bab9d249.productIntroEn: TravCozy keeps every part of your trip together. Ask ChatGPT about your travels and it answers from your real bookings — flights, hotels, trains, car rentals, and transfers imported from any booking site — organized into a day-by-day itinerary.
plugin_asdk_app_6a61c7e71c948191bab9d249.longDescription:
TravCozy keeps every part of your trip together. Ask ChatGPT about your travels and it answers from your real bookings — flights, hotels, trains, car rentals, and transfers imported from any booking site — organized into a day-by-day itinerary.

It also spots what's missing before you travel: nights without accommodation and arrivals with no onward transport. Add bookings right from the conversation by describing them, by uploading a confirmation file, or by forwarding booking emails to your TravCozy inbox — they're organized into the right trip automatically.

Requires a TravCozy account (travcozy.com).
plugin_asdk_app_6a61c7e71c948191bab9d249.longDescriptionZh:
TravCozy 将您旅行的每个部分整合在一起。向 ChatGPT 询问您的旅行，它会根据您的真实预订（从任何预订网站导入的航班、酒店、火车、汽车租赁和接送服务）进行回答，并组织成每日行程。

它还可以在您旅行前发现缺少的内容：没有住宿的夜晚以及没有后续交通的抵达。通过描述、上传确认文件或将预订电子邮件转发到您的 TravCozy 收件箱，直接从对话中添加预订 - 它们会自动组织到正确的行程中。

需要 TravCozy 帐户 (travcozy.com)。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7363eccc0081918443d90f.longDescription: Traffik measures the movement of the world's superyachts and private aviation from live public safety broadcasts. Ask for the weekly Traffik Index (100 = an ordinary week on the water), the measured pulse of any tracked yachting harbor — Monaco, Newport, Miami, Porto Cervo, the Hamptons and 150 more — plus private jets and helicopters into executive airports, or measured superyacht attendance at marquee events like the Monaco Grand Prix. Every number is a floor, not an estimate: only broadcasting vessels inside named geofences are counted, and every answer states its method and date.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5c7068518c8191b7dd7119.productIntro: FlatHunt 帮助人们从多家值得信赖的住房提供商那里找到柏林带家具的公寓、单间公寓和私人房间。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c7068518c8191b7dd7119.productIntroEn: FlatHunt helps people find furnished apartments, studios, and private rooms in Berlin from multiple trusted housing providers.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c7068518c8191b7dd7119.longDescription:
FlatHunt helps people find furnished apartments, studios, and private rooms in Berlin from multiple trusted housing providers.

Search by location, monthly budget, property type, number of rooms, size, move-in date, amenities, and other preferences. FlatHunt compares matching listings, presents the most relevant options in interactive cards, and links to the original provider page for current details and availability.

FlatHunt is designed for expats, professionals, students, couples, and anyone looking for furnished accommodation in Berlin.

Listings, prices, and availability may change. FlatHunt helps users discover and compare housing options but does not act as a landlord, property manager, or booking provider.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c7068518c8191b7dd7119.longDescriptionZh:
FlatHunt 帮助人们从多家值得信赖的住房提供商那里找到柏林带家具的公寓、单间公寓和私人房间。

按位置、每月预算、房产类型、房间数量、面积、入住日期、设施和其他偏好进行搜索。 FlatHunt 会比较匹配的列表，在交互式卡片中显示最相关的选项，并链接到原始提供商页面以获取当前详细信息和可用性。

FlatHunt 专为外籍人士、专业人士、学生、情侣以及任何在柏林寻找带家具的住宿的人而设计。

清单、价格和供货情况可能会发生变化。 FlatHunt 帮助用户发现和比较住房选择，但不充当房东、物业经理或预订提供商。

Find student rooms near TU Berlin under €900
Compare suitable listings from different providers and recommend the best one

plugin_asdk_app_6a9652bd634081918bf06611.productIntro: DRAIV 是瑞士苏黎世的无钥匙汽车租赁公司。询问您需要什么——周末用的 SUV、今晚的电动汽车、家庭用的七座汽车——DRAIV 会显示实际上免费的东西，并提供瑞士法郎的实际价格和直接预订链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9652bd634081918bf06611.productIntroEn: DRAIV is keyless car rental in Zurich, Switzerland. Ask for what you need — an SUV for the weekend, an electric car tonight, a seven-seater for the family — and DRAIV shows what is actually free, with real prices in Swiss francs and a direct link to book.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9652bd634081918bf06611.longDescription:
DRAIV is keyless car rental in Zurich, Switzerland. Ask for what you need — an SUV for the weekend, an electric car tonight, a seven-seater for the family — and DRAIV shows what is actually free, with real prices in Swiss francs and a direct link to book.

There is no rental counter, no key handover and no deposit blocked on your card. You unlock the car with your phone, so pickup works at any hour, including after a late flight. Cars stand at fixed locations across Zurich (City, Altstetten, Oerlikon) and at Zurich Airport, where you collect the car right at the terminal parking on rentals of two days or more.

Booking finishes on draiv.ch in your browser. No app to install.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9652bd634081918bf06611.longDescriptionZh:
DRAIV 是瑞士苏黎世的无钥匙汽车租赁公司。询问您需要什么——周末用的 SUV、今晚的电动汽车、家庭用的七座汽车——DRAIV 会显示实际上免费的东西，并提供瑞士法郎的实际价格和直接预订链接。

没有租赁柜台，没有钥匙交接，卡上的押金也不会被冻结。您可以使用手机解锁汽车，因此可以随时接车，包括航班晚点后。汽车停放在苏黎世（市区、阿尔特施滕、欧瑞康）和苏黎世机场的固定地点，您可以在航站楼停车场取车，租期为两天或以上。

在浏览器中的 driv.ch 上完成预订。无需安装应用程序。

plugin_asdk_app_6a99bd594da4819190de08da.productIntroEn: Aviation reference tools for analysts, researchers and product teams. Resolve airports, airlines, aircraft types, registrations and flight identifiers with confidence, historical validity and source provenance. Inspect airport network integration, operator and ownership facts, engagement exceptions, connectivity and passenger-size bands.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99bd594da4819190de08da.longDescription: Aviation reference tools for analysts, researchers and product teams. plugin_asdk_app_6a98926fdab081919b016b0b.name: pickthehotel
plugin_asdk_app_6a98926fdab081919b016b0b.productIntro: pickthehotel 是酒店的答案引擎。与其一堵墙的结果，不如询问一家符合您在城市意图的酒店，并获得一个自信的选择、一些替代方案和一个预订链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6a98926fdab081919b016b0b.productIntroEn: pickthehotel is an answer engine for hotels. Instead of a wall of results, ask for the one hotel that fits your intent in a city and get a single confident pick, a few alternatives, and a booking link.
plugin_asdk_app_6a98926fdab081919b016b0b.longDescription:
pickthehotel is an answer engine for hotels. Instead of a wall of results, ask for the one hotel that fits your intent in a city and get a single confident pick, a few alternatives, and a booking link.

Choose an intent:
• iconic - the standout in town
• value - great, and fairly priced for what you get
• budget - cheap, clean, and genuinely central
• family - one room that actually sleeps two adults and the children

Every hotel is judged the same way - value (punching above its price), location (closeness to what you actually came for), and reviews (weighted by confidence, not just averaged) - with no paid placement. You can anchor "central" to a landmark ("near the Louvre") or to your live location, and you can ask for a curated list of long-established hotels around the world.

Live in Zürich, Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Bangkok, Dubai, Singapore, Istanbul, and Hong Kong, with more rolling out. Prices are indicative and confirmed at the booking site; booking links are affiliate and disclosed.
plugin_asdk_app_6a98926fdab081919b016b0b.longDescriptionZh:
pickthehotel 是酒店的答案引擎。与其一堵墙的结果，不如询问一家符合您在城市意图的酒店，并获得一个自信的选择、一些替代方案和一个预订链接。

选择一个意图：
• 标志性的——镇上的佼佼者
• 物有所值 - 非常好，而且价格合理
• 预算 - 便宜、干净、位于真正的中心位置
• 家庭房 - 一间房间实际上可容纳两名成人和儿童

每家酒店都以相同的方式进行评判——价值（高于其价格）、位置（与您实际目的的接近程度）和评论（按置信度加权，而不仅仅是平均）——没有付费排名。您可以将“中心”定位到地标（“卢浮宫附近”）或您居住的位置，并且可以要求提供世界各地历史悠久的酒店的精选列表。

生活在苏黎世、巴黎、伦敦、纽约、东京、曼谷、迪拜、新加坡、伊斯坦布尔和香港，更多活动即将推出。价格为指示性价格，并在预订网站确认；预订链接是附属链接并已公开。

A great-value hotel in Tokyo near Shinjuku

plugin_asdk_app_6a2205850da88191892202b3.name: Roam Rule
plugin_asdk_app_6a2205850da88191892202b3.productIntro: Roam Rule 是一款税务居住追踪和旅行限制应用程序，适用于需要可靠记录自己的天数累计情况的外籍人士、创始人、顾问、机组人员和经常旅行者。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2205850da88191892202b3.productIntroEn: Roam Rule is a tax residency tracker and travel limits app for expats, founders, consultants, aircrew and frequent travellers who need a trustworthy record of where their days are adding up.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2205850da88191892202b3.longDescription:
Roam Rule is a tax residency tracker and travel limits app for expats, founders, consultants, aircrew and frequent travellers who need a trustworthy record of where their days are adding up.

The mobile app keeps your travel record up to date in the background, shows where you have been on a map and helps you stay ahead of tax residency, Schengen 90/180, visa and time-away limits, custom limits, alerts, tax signals and days needing review.

In ChatGPT, you can ask plain-English questions about your Roam Rule record before booking a trip, checking a Schengen stay, preparing for an adviser call or setting up a regular check-in. Ask about logged countries, current counters, upcoming thresholds and unresolved travel days, then get a quick visual summary of what needs attention next.

With Roam Rule in ChatGPT you can:

- check where your travel days are adding up before booking a trip
- ask what to review before another Schengen or visa-sensitive journey
- use a planned itinerary in the conversation to ask what counters you should check first
- prepare a quick summary before speaking to an accountant, adviser or immigration professional
- set a regular ChatGPT check-in to remind you to review your Roam Rule counters and days needing attention
plugin_asdk_app_6a2205850da88191892202b3.longDescriptionZh:
Roam Rule 是一款税务居住追踪和旅行限制应用程序，适用于需要可靠记录自己的天数累计情况的外籍人士、创始人、顾问、机组人员和经常旅行者。

该移动应用程序在后台保持您的旅行记录最新，在地图上显示您去过的地方，并帮助您提前了解税务居住地、申根 90/180、签证和休假限制、自定义限制、警报、税务信号和需要审核的天数。

在 ChatGPT 中，您可以在预订旅行、检查申根住宿、​​准备顾问电话或设置定期入住之前询问有关漫游规则记录的简单英语问题。询问已记录的国家/地区、当前计数器、即将到来的阈值和未解决的旅行日期，然后快速直观地总结下一步需要注意的事项。

通过 ChatGPT 中的漫游规则，您可以：

- 在预订行程之前检查您的旅行天数累计情况
- 询问在另一次申根或签证敏感旅程之前要检查什么
- 在对话中使用计划行程来询问您应该首先检查哪些柜台
- 在与会计师、顾问或移民专业人士交谈之前准备一份快速摘要
- 设置定期 ChatGPT 签入，提醒您查看漫游规则计数器和需要注意的日期

It matches stays to your itinerary: close to your activities and restaurants, within your budget, and well located so you spend your trip exploring instead of commuting. Get personalized recommendations by location, price, amenities, and vibe—from budget boutiques to full-service chains.

plugin_asdk_app_6a8d81ae14788191a615c100.name: Musafir.com: Visa & Travel
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d81ae14788191a615c100.productIntro: Musafir.com Visa 通过 Musafir.com 的实时产品目录解答签证问题：您是否需要签证、签证费用是多少、需要哪些文件、需要多长时间以及 Musafir.com 是否可以为您处理。如果签证需要亲自预约，它还会显示已公布的可用签证中心以及它们上次显示为开放的日期，因此您可以大致了解在做出任何承诺之前多久是现实的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d81ae14788191a615c100.productIntroEn: Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d81ae14788191a615c100.longDescription:
Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you. Where a visa needs an in-person appointment, it also shows the visa centres with published availability and the dates they were last showing as open, so you can see roughly how soon is realistic before you commit to anything.

Visa rules, fees and processing times change constantly and differ by the passport you hold, so remembered or published figures are routinely out of date for the person asking. Every answer here comes from the catalogue that prices Musafir.com's own bookings, and each one names the market it applies to.

Ask about a destination, compare several, or check what paperwork you need and how each document is handed over, whether that is uploaded online, taken to a visa centre or couriered. When you are ready to apply, you are handed the matching page on Musafir.com with your details already carried across, and Musafir.com books the appointment for you once your application is in.

Musafir.com currently serves travellers applying from the UAE. If you live somewhere Musafir.com does not yet cover, the connector says so rather than quoting you a price for a process you cannot use.

This connector is read-only. It cannot access your account, view or change an order, hold or book an appointment, or take a payment. Appointment availability is what the visa centre was last publishing, not a reservation and not a guarantee. It tells you what Musafir.com can process, which is not the same as what a government requires, and it never predicts whether a visa will be approved.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d81ae14788191a615c100.longDescriptionZh:
Musafir.com Visa 通过 Musafir.com 的实时产品目录解答签证问题：您是否需要签证、签证费用是多少、需要哪些文件、需要多长时间以及 Musafir.com 是否可以为您处理。如果签证需要亲自预约，它还会显示已公布的可用签证中心以及它们上次显示为开放的日期，因此您可以大致了解在做出任何承诺之前多久是现实的。

签证规则、费用和处理时间不断变化，并且因您持有的护照而异，因此记忆或公布的数据对于询问者来说通常已经过时。这里的每个答案都来自 Musafir.com 自己的预订定价目录，并且每个答案都指出了其适用的市场。

询问目的地，比较几个目的地，或者检查您需要哪些文件以及每份文件的移交方式，无论是在线上传、带到签证中心还是快递。当您准备好申请时，您会收到 Musafir.com 上的匹配页面，其中已包含您的详细信息，一旦您的申请提交，Musafir.com 就会为您预约。

Musafir.com 目前为来自阿联酋的旅客提供服务。如果您住在 Musafir.com 尚未覆盖的地方，连接器会这样说明，而不是为您无法使用的流程报出价格。

该连接器是只读的。它无法访问您的帐户、查看或更改订单、保留或预订约会或接受付款。预约可用性是签证中心最后发布的信息，不是预订，也不是保证。它告诉您 Musafir.com 可以处理什么，这与政府要求的不同，并且它从不预测签证是否会获得批准。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9a8d3450b8819183599304.productIntro: 现在直接在 ChatGPT 中发现并计划您的丽笙住宿。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a8d3450b8819183599304.productIntroEn: Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a8d3450b8819183599304.longDescription:
Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.

Just describe what you’re looking for, and the app helps you search and compare Radisson properties with up-to-date rates, location context, and practical hotel details. You can explore results on an interactive map, quickly understand which options are closest to the places that matter to you, and compare hotels by price, amenities, and overall fit without jumping between multiple tabs.

Whether you’re planning far ahead or figuring things out last minute, you can refine your search in seconds by adjusting destination, dates, budget, or preferences as you chat. The experience is designed to keep planning easy from start to finish: ask, compare, narrow down, and choose with confidence.

Try prompts like:
 - Find Radisson hotels near downtown Amsterdam for next weekend
 - Show options with breakfast included and a fitness center
 - Get me the best-value stays near the airport
 - Which Radisson hotel is best for walkable dining and shopping?

When you’re ready, just select the option you like, and the app gives you a direct booking link to complete your Radisson reservation with ease. No payment is processed within ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a8d3450b8819183599304.longDescriptionZh:
现在直接在 ChatGPT 中发现并计划您的丽笙住宿。

只需描述您要寻找的内容，该应用程序即可帮助您搜索和比较丽笙酒店的最新价格、位置背景和实用的酒店详细信息。您可以在交互式地图上探索结果，快速了解哪些选项距离您重要的地点最近，并按价格、设施和整体适合度比较酒店，而无需在多个选项卡之间跳转。

无论您是提前计划还是在最后一刻解决问题，您都可以通过在聊天时调整目的地、日期、预算或偏好来在几秒钟内优化您的搜索。该体验旨在让计划从头到尾变得轻松：询问、比较、缩小范围并充满信心地选择。

尝试如下提示：
 - 查找下周末阿姆斯特丹市中心附近的丽笙酒店
 - 含早餐和健身中心的显示选项
 - 为我提供机场附近最超值的住宿
 - 哪家丽笙酒店最适合步行就餐和购物？

准备好后，只需选择您喜欢的选项，应用程序就会为您提供直接预订链接，以便您轻松完成丽笙酒店的预订。 ChatGPT 内不处理任何付款。

As one of the largest travel platforms in Saudi Arabia and the nearby regions, Flyin is trusted by more than one million customers for seamless air ticket booking and travel experiences.

With a solid track record of 15+ years, we have helped our travellers find great deals, with offerings like flexible fares for families, tailor-made itineraries, and convenient fly-now-pay-later options.

From over 450 airline options to an extensive hotel network to convenient direct flights and diverse travel packages, planning your journey is refreshingly simple.

With value-added services like EzCancel, FlexiFly, travel insurance, and smart delay protection, Flyin gives our customers the level of reassurance booking with flights and hotels that few platforms offer.

plugin_asdk_app_6a965d41427c81918a48d808.name: eSIMradar
plugin_asdk_app_6a965d41427c81918a48d808.description: 比较旅行 eSIM 计划
plugin_asdk_app_6a965d41427c81918a48d808.productIntro: eSIMradar 比较了 210 多个目的地的 60 多家提供商的预付费旅行 eSIM 数据计划，以便旅行者可以了解他们要去的地方的移动数据实际费用是多少。
plugin_asdk_app_6a965d41427c81918a48d808.productIntroEn: eSIMradar compares prepaid travel eSIM data plans from 60+ providers across 210+ destinations, so a traveller can see what mobile data actually costs where they are going.
plugin_asdk_app_6a965d41427c81918a48d808.longDescription:
eSIMradar compares prepaid travel eSIM data plans from 60+ providers across 210+ destinations, so a traveller can see what mobile data actually costs where they are going.

Ask for a destination and it returns a ranked shortlist with the data allowance, validity, total price in USD and price per gigabyte, alongside the true size of the catalogue it drew from. Narrow by data need, trip length, budget, or features like 5G, hotspot sharing and top-up. Ask about one plan and it returns the detail that decides a purchase: fair-use throttling, whether the allowance is per day, the activation model, whether identity verification is required, which carriers it roams on, and which other countries it covers. Ask about a provider and it returns coverage, catalogue size, reader reviews and how much of that provider we have verified.

Results are ranked over the whole catalogue for a destination rather than a promoted subset, and no provider is allowed to occupy the shortlist. Prices are rebuilt from provider catalogues continuously.

eSIMradar earns affiliate commission when a reader buys through the site. That relationship decides which plans the website puts forward on one of its tabs; it never orders the results these tools return. Every plan links to its page on esimradar.com, where the reader compares and completes any purchase.
plugin_asdk_app_6a965d41427c81918a48d808.longDescriptionZh:
eSIMradar 比较了 210 多个目的地的 60 多家提供商的预付费旅行 eSIM 数据计划，以便旅行者可以了解他们要去的地方的移动数据实际费用是多少。

询问一个目的地，它会返回一个排名候选列表，其中包含数据限额、有效性、美元总价和每 GB 价格，以及它所提取的目录的真实大小。根据数据需求、行程长度、预算或 5G、热点共享和充值等功能缩小范围。询问一项计划，它会返回决定购买的详细信息：合理使用限制、津贴是否按天计算、激活模式、是否需要身份验证、漫游的运营商以及覆盖哪些其他国家/地区。询问某个提供商，它会返回覆盖范围、目录大小、读者评论以及我们已验证该提供商的数量。

结果是根据目的地的整个目录而不是升级的子集进行排名的，并且不允许任何提供商占据候选名单。价格是根据供应商目录不断重建的。

当读者通过该网站购买时，eSIMradar 即可赚取联属佣金。这种关系决定了网站在其一个选项卡上提出哪些计划；它从不命令这些工具返回的结果。每个计划都链接到 esimradar.com 上的页面，读者可以在其中进行比较并完成购买。

plugin_asdk_app_6a60c104be8c81919be97558.productIntro: Stayonomy 以真实的、可预订的价格而不是预估价格来回答旅行问题。它比较了两个城市之间的各种交通方式——航班、火车、公共汽车和渡轮——以及持续时间和当前缓存票价（以欧元为单位）；找到最便宜的飞行日期和月份；列出每晚价格的酒店；并涵盖行程的其余部分：目的地租车、预付费旅行 eSIM 计划（包含 200 多个目的地的目录价格）、旅游和门票、城市指南以及每月气候建议。
plugin_asdk_app_6a60c104be8c81919be97558.productIntroEn: Stayonomy answers travel questions with real, bookable prices instead of estimates. It compares every way to get between two cities - flight, train, bus and ferry - with durations and current cached fares in EUR; finds the cheapest days and months to fly; lists hotels with nightly rates; and covers the rest of the trip too: car rental at the destination, prepaid travel eSIM plans with ca…
plugin_asdk_app_6a60c104be8c81919be97558.longDescription:
Stayonomy answers travel questions with real, bookable prices instead of estimates. It compares every way to get between two cities - flight, train, bus and ferry - with durations and current cached fares in EUR; finds the cheapest days and months to fly; lists hotels with nightly rates; and covers the rest of the trip too: car rental at the destination, prepaid travel eSIM plans with catalog prices for 200+ destinations, tours and tickets, city guides, and month-by-month climate advice.

Fares are real prices travellers found recently, refreshed daily and served from Stayonomy's own database - every answer says how fresh the data is, and the booking site confirms the final price. All tools are read-only; the app needs no account and collects no personal data. Booking links may contain affiliate identifiers, which is how Stayonomy is funded; this never affects the prices shown.

Operated by Starcode Services Kft. (Budapest, Hungary).
plugin_asdk_app_6a60c104be8c81919be97558.longDescriptionZh:
Stayonomy 以真实的、可预订的价格而不是预估价格来回答旅行问题。它比较了两个城市之间的各种交通方式——航班、火车、公共汽车和渡轮——以及持续时间和当前缓存票价（以欧元为单位）；找到最便宜的飞行日期和月份；列出每晚价格的酒店；并涵盖行程的其余部分：目的地租车、预付费旅行 eSIM 计划（包含 200 多个目的地的目录价格）、旅游和门票、城市指南以及每月气候建议。

票价是旅行者最近发现的真实价格，每天都会更新，并由 Stayonomy 自己的数据库提供 - 每个答案都表明数据有多新鲜，预订网站会确认最终价格。所有工具都是只读的；该应用程序不需要帐户，也不收集任何个人数据。预订链接可能包含附属标识符，这就是 Stayonomy 的资金来源；这永远不会影响显示的价格。

由 Starcode Services Kft 运营。 （匈牙利布达佩斯）。

Bonjour RATP vous aide à trouver le meilleur itinéraire en transports en commun en Île‑de‑France, rien que pour vous.

L’application calcule des trajets multimodaux en combinant l’ensemble des réseaux : métro, RER, Transilien, bus et tramway. Chaque proposition tient compte de l’information trafic en temps réel, des perturbations et des travaux en cours afin de vous proposer des trajets fiables et adaptés.

Que vous prépariez un déplacement ou que vous cherchiez le meilleur chemin pour partir maintenant, Bonjour RATP vous permet de comparer les options disponibles et de choisir l’itinéraire le plus pertinent pour votre trajet.

plugin_asdk_app_6a9c87b4d6188191b233d20f.longDescription: TripCanvas is an AI travel agent, trip planner, and travel itinerary builder inside ChatGPT. It turns your dates, destination, interests, constraints, preferred pace, and travel companions into a complete public trip website: a geographically coherent route, day-by-day itinerary, overnight bases, driving distances, road names, maps, places to see, and priority bookings in one shareable link for the whole group. Users connect a TripCanvas account through OAuth; one new website is included per UTC month, while reopening and sharing do not consume another allowance unit. When no allowance remains, the plugin shows the reset date and links only to an informational account-and-allowance page. It never displays prices or initiates a purchase inside ChatGPT.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa2be7123248191bd3ef3b1.name: Piazza in Festa
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2be7123248191bd3ef3b1.description: 意大利小镇活动和集市
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2be7123248191bd3ef3b1.productIntro: 节日广场回答了有关意大利城镇正在发生的事情的问题：乡村盛宴、守护神节日、食品和葡萄酒博览会、街头市场、音乐会和展览。该目录每天都会根据市政厅依法必须在其官方登记册上发布的通知进行重建，因此它还涵盖了其他日历中没有列出的非常小的城镇。用户可以按城镇、地区、类别、自由文本或日期范围进行搜索，打开单个活动以获取日期、地点和组织者等实用详细信息，并询问某个地区涵盖哪些城镇。每个结果都带有指向活动页面及其来源的官方文档的链接，因此可以验证答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2be7123248191bd3ef3b1.productIntroEn: Piazza in Festa answers questions about what is happening in Italian towns: village feasts, patron saint festivals, food and wine fairs, street markets, concerts and exhibitions. The catalogue is rebuilt every day from the notices that town halls are legally required to publish on their official register, so it also covers very small towns that no other calendar lists.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2be7123248191bd3ef3b1.longDescription: Piazza in Festa answers questions about what is happening in Italian towns: village feasts, patron saint festivals, food and wine fairs, street markets, concerts and exhibitions. The catalogue is rebuilt every day from the notices that town halls are legally required to publish on their official register, so it also covers very small towns that no other calendar lists. Users can search by town, region, category, free text or date range, open a single event for practical details such as dates, venue and organiser, and ask which towns are covered in a region. Every result carries a link to the event page and to the official document it was derived from, so answers can be verified.

plugin_asdk_app_6a1f5aa83f888191845b774b.productIntro: Tineo 通过 ChatGPT 帮助您组织旅行计划。连接您的 Tineo 帐户以查找您的行程、查看行程详细信息，并将航班、住宿、交通和活动放在一起。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f5aa83f888191845b774b.productIntroEn: Tineo helps you organize travel plans through ChatGPT. Connect your Tineo account to find your trips, view itinerary details, and keep flights, stays, transport, and activities together.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f5aa83f888191845b774b.longDescription:
Tineo helps you organize travel plans through ChatGPT. Connect your Tineo account to find your trips, view itinerary details, and keep flights, stays, transport, and activities together.

Create a trip, add itinerary items, and update saved travel details in conversation. Look up places and check the available flight information for saved flight segments. Your itinerary stays in your Tineo account so you can return to it later.

A Tineo account is required. Editing a saved itinerary changes your Tineo records; it does not change a reservation with an airline, hotel, or other travel provider.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f5aa83f888191845b774b.longDescriptionZh:
Tineo 通过 ChatGPT 帮助您组织旅行计划。连接您的 Tineo 帐户以查找您的行程、查看行程详细信息，并将航班、住宿、交通和活动放在一起。

创建旅行、添加行程项目并更新对话中保存的旅行详细信息。查找地点并检查已保存航段的可用航班信息。您的行程保留在您的 Tineo 帐户中，以便您稍后可以返回。

需要一个 Tineo 帐户。编辑已保存的行程会更改您的 Tineo 记录；它不会更改航空公司、酒店或其他旅行提供商的预订。
defaultPrompts: Show my upcoming trips.
Show the itinerary for my next trip.
Show the hotel details for my next trip.
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我即将到来的旅行。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa3a5403d348191b9a148c5.productIntro: Futrumi 是一个捷克美食小贴士平台：知名美食评论家、厨师、侍酒师和美食记者分享他们真正喜欢的饮食地点以及他们推荐的具体菜肴或饮料。该插件将整理、发布的数据引入 ChatGPT，这样您就可以询问今晚 Vinohrady 去哪里吃饭，或者 Michal Danek 推荐什么，并获得真正的专家意见，而不是汇总的评论分数。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3a5403d348191b9a148c5.productIntroEn: Futrumi is a Czech food-tip platform: named food critics, chefs, sommeliers and gastronomy journalists share where they actually like to eat and drink, and the exact dish or drink they recommend. This plugin brings that curated, published data into ChatGPT, so you can ask where to eat in Vinohrady tonight, or what Michal Danek recommends, and get real expert opinions instead of aggregate…
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3a5403d348191b9a148c5.longDescription:
Futrumi is a Czech food-tip platform: named food critics, chefs, sommeliers and gastronomy journalists share where they actually like to eat and drink, and the exact dish or drink they recommend. This plugin brings that curated, published data into ChatGPT, so you can ask where to eat in Vinohrady tonight, or what Michal Danek recommends, and get real expert opinions instead of aggregated review scores.

Every result carries the expert's name, their quote in the original Czech, the venue with address and opening hours, and a link to open it in the Futrumi app. Coverage spans restaurants, cafes, bars, bakeries and wine shops, primarily in Prague and Brno.

Data covers Czechia only. A question about Vienna or Bratislava returns an explicit "no recommendations found" rather than a guess. Quotes stay in the original Czech so the expert's wording is preserved, and ChatGPT can translate them on request. Everything served is already published in the Futrumi app, with no private or pre-publication content. The plugin is read-only and anonymous: no account, no API key.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3a5403d348191b9a148c5.longDescriptionZh:
Futrumi 是一个捷克美食小贴士平台：知名美食评论家、厨师、侍酒师和美食记者分享他们真正喜欢的饮食地点以及他们推荐的具体菜肴或饮料。该插件将整理、发布的数据引入 ChatGPT，这样您就可以询问今晚 Vinohrady 去哪里吃饭，或者 Michal Danek 推荐什么，并获得真正的专家意见，而不是汇总的评论分数。

每个结果都带有专家的姓名、捷克语原文、地点、地址和开放时间，以及在 Futrumi 应用程序中打开它的链接。覆盖范围涵盖餐厅、咖啡馆、酒吧、面包店和葡萄酒商店，主要位于布拉格和布尔诺。

数据仅涵盖捷克。有关维也纳或布拉迪斯拉发的问题会返回明确的“未找到建议”，而不是猜测。引言保留在捷克语原文中，因此专家的措辞得以保留，并且 ChatGPT 可以根据要求进行翻译。所提供的所有内容均已在 Futrumi 应用程序中发布，没有私人或预发布内容。该插件是只读且匿名的：没有帐户，没有 API 密钥。

plugin_asdk_app_6a92694ffcfc8191ba654480.productIntro: Secret World — Hidden Gems 让 ChatGPT 可以直接访问包含全球 340,000 多个鲜为人知的地点和 750,000 多张原始照片的精选目录。
plugin_asdk_app_6a92694ffcfc8191ba654480.productIntroEn: Secret World — Hidden Gems gives ChatGPT direct access to a curated catalog of 340,000+ lesser-known places and 750,000+ original photos worldwide.
plugin_asdk_app_6a92694ffcfc8191ba654480.longDescription:
Secret World — Hidden Gems gives ChatGPT direct access to a curated catalog of 340,000+ lesser-known places and 750,000+ original photos worldwide.

Ask for hidden gems near any city, less touristy alternatives to famous landmarks ("I've seen the Colosseum — what am I missing nearby?"), or unusual places worth a small detour on a road trip. Every result is a real place with verified coordinates, an original photo and a source page on Secret World (sworld.co.uk).

The app is read-only and requires no account: it never asks for, stores or processes any personal data. Famous landmarks are filtered out by design — this app is only about the places most visitors miss.
plugin_asdk_app_6a92694ffcfc8191ba654480.longDescriptionZh:
Secret World — Hidden Gems 让 ChatGPT 可以直接访问包含全球 340,000 多个鲜为人知的地点和 750,000 多张原始照片的精选目录。

询问任何城市附近隐藏的瑰宝、著名地标的游客较少的替代品（“我看过罗马斗兽场 - 我在附近错过了什么？”），或者在公路旅行中值得绕道的不寻常的地方。每个结果都是真实地点，具有经过验证的坐标、原始照片和 Secret World (sworld.co.uk) 上的源页面。

该应用程序是只读的，不需要帐户：它从不要求、存储或处理任何个人数据。著名的地标在设计上被过滤掉了——这个应用程序只涉及大多数游客错过的地方。

Klook helps you discover and book things to do wherever you are. Describe what you're looking for — your destination, dates, and interests — and get a list of relevant options with important details like price, reviews, and photos.

plugin_asdk_app_69c1b387534881918fee1782.longDescription:
The Archer Hotel app for ChatGPT lets you explore Archer Hotel locations and access key details directly within your conversation. You can view information about each property, including amenities, services, and general hotel features.

You can also check current room rates and availability based on your travel dates, without needing to leave ChatGPT. If you decide to book, you’ll be directed to the official booking page to complete your reservation.

您还可以根据您的旅行日期查看当前房价和空房情况，而无需离开 ChatGPT。如果您决定预订，您将被引导至官方预订页面以完成预订。

plugin_asdk_app_69eeea4b731c8191b63e4bd6.productIntro: Hotel Liabeny Assistant可帮助客人通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见的预订任务。 用户可以询问有关Hotel Liabeny酒店的问题，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策和入住/退房时间。助理还可以检查房间可用性并列出可选的房间附加服务。 如果客人已经预订，助理可以检索预订详细信息，并在提供所需的预订信息后帮助修改或取消现有预订。 如果客人需要帮助，助理还可以帮助创建新的预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
plugin_asdk_app_69eeea4b731c8191b63e4bd6.productIntroEn: Hotel Liabeny Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat. Users can ask questions about Hotel Liabeny, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
plugin_asdk_app_69eeea4b731c8191b63e4bd6.longDescription:
Hotel Liabeny Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Hotel Liabeny, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Hotel Liabeny?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

Note: Some reservation actions may require providing booking details such as reservation code or guest information.
plugin_asdk_app_69eeea4b731c8191b63e4bd6.longDescriptionZh:
Hotel Liabeny Assistant可帮助客人通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见的预订任务。
用户可以询问有关Hotel Liabeny酒店的问题，包括客房、设施、酒店服务、政策和入住/退房时间。助理还可以检查房间可用性并列出可选的房间附加服务。
如果客人已经预订，助理可以检索预订详细信息，并在提供所需的预订信息后帮助修改或取消现有预订。
如果客人需要帮助，助理还可以帮助创建新的预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
您可以提出的示例问题：
“何时可在利亚贝尼酒店办理入住？”
“下周末还有房间吗？”
“显示可用的房型。”
“修改我的预订日期。”
“取消我的预订。”
“请联系酒店以帮助我预订。”

注意：某些预订操作可能需要提供预订详细信息，例如预订代码或客人信息。
defaultPrompts: What time is check-in/check-out, and does it have a swimming pool?
defaultPromptsZh: 入住/退房时间是什么时候？有游泳池吗？

plugin_asdk_app_6a0e8ef566a081919bfdc00e.description: 查找前往目的地的最佳路线。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0e8ef566a081919bfdc00e.productIntro: 通过 Kakao T 计划您前往目的地的旅程。 如果您告诉我们人数、情况以及目的地，我们将建议最佳路线，包括火车、巴士和私家车。 您可以一目了然地比较每种方式的预计时间和费用，找到适合您的交通方式，甚至可以通过Kakao T应用程序进行实际预订和打电话。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0e8ef566a081919bfdc00e.productIntroEn: 카카오 T와 함께 목적지까지의 이동 계획을 세워보세요. 목적지와 함께 인원이나 상황을 이야기하면 기차, 버스, 자차를 아우르는 최적의 경로를 제안합니다. 각 수단별 예상 시간과 비용을 한눈에 비교해 나에게 딱 맞는 이동 방법을 찾을 수 있으며, 실제 예약과 호출까지 카카오 T 앱에서 간편하게 연결됩니다.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0e8ef566a081919bfdc00e.longDescription:
카카오 T와 함께 목적지까지의 이동 계획을 세워보세요.
목적지와 함께 인원이나 상황을 이야기하면 기차, 버스, 자차를 아우르는 최적의 경로를 제안합니다.
각 수단별 예상 시간과 비용을 한눈에 비교해 나에게 딱 맞는 이동 방법을 찾을 수 있으며, 실제 예약과 호출까지 카카오 T 앱에서 간편하게 연결됩니다.

※ 안내되는 정보에는 AI가 생성한 내용이 포함될 수 있으며, 실시간 교통 상황에 따른 정확한 정보는 카카오 T 앱에서 확인하시는 것이 좋습니다.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0e8ef566a081919bfdc00e.longDescriptionZh:
通过 Kakao T 计划您前往目的地的旅程。
如果您告诉我们人数、情况以及目的地，我们将建议最佳路线，包括火车、巴士和私家车。
您可以一目了然地比较每种方式的预计时间和费用，找到适合您的交通方式，甚至可以通过Kakao T应用程序进行实际预订和打电话。

※ 所提供的信息可能包含人工智能生成的内容，建议您根据实时路况查看Kakao T应用程序以获取准确信息。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4bc24dcbfc8191b45247f5.name: BookYolo
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bc24dcbfc8191b45247f5.description: 检查您下次入住的健康状况
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bc24dcbfc8191b45247f5.productIntro: BookYolo 是一款人工智能驱动的旅行工具，旨在帮助您在预订前检查酒店和度假屋的质量。该平台分析公开列表信息和客人反馈，以发现致命缺陷、隐藏的危险信号、评论模式、过度销售和营销技巧、费用意外以及旅行者经常错过的期望差距。 BookYolo 超越了评级和表面评论，通过 100 点检查对每处房产进行深入分析。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bc24dcbfc8191b45247f5.productIntroEn: BookYolo is an AI-powered travel tool designed to help you inspect the quality of hotels and vacation rentals before you book them. The platform analyzes public listing information and guest feedback to surface fatal flaws, hidden red flags, review patterns, overselling and marketing techniques, fee surprises and expectation gaps that travelers often miss.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bc24dcbfc8191b45247f5.longDescription:
BookYolo is an AI-powered travel tool designed to help you inspect the quality of hotels and vacation rentals before you book them. The platform analyzes public listing information and guest feedback to surface fatal flaws,  hidden red flags, review patterns, overselling and marketing techniques, fee surprises and expectation gaps that travelers often miss. BookYolo goes beyond ratings and surface level reviews by running a deep analysis of each property through a 100-point inspection.

Many properties appear highly rated online, yet travelers still run into unexpected issues on arrival. Reviews are often influenced by politeness bias, where guests soften criticism or focus on positives. At the same time, unhappy guests do not always leave reviews at all, which further skews the overall picture. Add to that the sheer volume of reviews, often hundreds per listing, and it becomes unrealistic for travelers to read and interpret everything themselves.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bc24dcbfc8191b45247f5.longDescriptionZh:
BookYolo 是一款人工智能驱动的旅行工具，旨在帮助您在预订前检查酒店和度假屋的质量。该平台分析公开列表信息和客人反馈，以发现致命缺陷、隐藏的危险信号、评论模式、过度销售和营销技巧、费用意外以及旅行者经常错过的期望差距。 BookYolo 超越了评级和表面评论，通过 100 点检查对每处房产进行深入分析。

许多酒店在网上评价很高，但旅行者在抵达时仍然会遇到意想不到的问题。评论常常受到礼貌偏见的影响，客人会软化批评或关注积极的一面。与此同时，不满意的客人并不总是留下评论，这进一步扭曲了整体情况。再加上评论数量巨大，每个房源通常有数百条评论，旅行者自己阅读和解释所有内容变得不现实。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6b3177ec8081919da0b2d3.productIntro: Motion4rent 可让您通过值得信赖的当地合作伙伴网络，在全球数千个城市查找和比较移动设备租赁 — 手动和电动轮椅、移动滑板车、膝助行器、助行车和类似的移动辅助设备。它仅涵盖行动辅助设备：不包括自行车、电动自行车、摩托车或汽车。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b3177ec8081919da0b2d3.productIntroEn: Motion4rent lets you find and compare mobility equipment rentals — manual and electric wheelchairs, mobility scooters, knee walkers, rollators and similar mobility aids — in thousands of cities worldwide, through a network of trusted local partners. It covers mobility aids only: not bicycles, e-bikes, motorbikes or cars.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b3177ec8081919da0b2d3.longDescription:
Motion4rent lets you find and compare mobility equipment rentals — manual and electric wheelchairs, mobility scooters, knee walkers, rollators and similar mobility aids — in thousands of cities worldwide, through a network of trusted local partners. It covers mobility aids only: not bicycles, e-bikes, motorbikes or cars.

Tell the assistant your city and travel dates and it finds available equipment with the FINAL price (taxes and management fee already included — no surprises), product photos, key specs (max weight, range, folding, type) and the delivery options that actually apply: store pickup, delivery to your home, hotel or apartment, airport, or cruise port. Prices can be shown in the currency you choose, and free-cancellation and deposit terms are shown up front.

When you're ready to book, it links you to the Motion4rent website, where you complete the reservation and payment securely. The app itself never takes a booking, never charges you and never asks for personal or payment details.

Ideal for travelers with reduced mobility, people recovering from surgery, families arranging equipment for an elderly relative, or anyone who needs mobility gear at their destination without carrying their own.

Operated by Motion4rent (TimetoMobility S.L.).
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b3177ec8081919da0b2d3.longDescriptionZh:
Motion4rent 可让您通过值得信赖的当地合作伙伴网络，在全球数千个城市查找和比较移动设备租赁 — 手动和电动轮椅、移动滑板车、膝助行器、助行车和类似的移动辅助设备。它仅涵盖行动辅助设备：不包括自行车、电动自行车、摩托车或汽车。

告诉助手您的城市和旅行日期，它会找到可用的设备，包括最终价格（已包括税费和管理费 - 毫不奇怪）、产品照片、关键规格（最大重量、范围、折叠、类型）以及实际适用的交付选项：商店提货、交付到您的家、酒店或公寓、机场或游轮港口。价格可以以您选择的货币显示，并且免费取消和存款条款会显示在前面。

当您准备好预订时，它会将您链接到 Motion4rent 网站，您可以在其中安全地完成预订和付款。该应用程序本身从不接受预订，从不向您收费，也从不询问个人或付款详细信息。

非常适合行动不便的旅行者、手术后康复的人、为年老亲戚准备设备的家庭，或在目的地需要移动装备而不携带自己的任何人。

由 Motion4rent (TimetoMobility S.L.) 运营。

plugin_asdk_app_6a777414cb308191b809fc1b.description: 更智能地计划旅行和打包
plugin_asdk_app_6a777414cb308191b809fc1b.productIntro: PackRat 帮助户外旅行者计划旅行并制定更好的装箱单。通过关键词或自然语言搜索户外装备的大型目录，比较产品的重量和价格，并整理装箱清单，分析总重量以及基础、磨损和消耗品明细。寻求较轻的替代品来代替最重的物品，查找特定旅行的间隙，检查目的地的近期天气预报，浏览户外指南，并将旅行和背包保存到与移动应用程序同步的 PackRat 帐户。
plugin_asdk_app_6a777414cb308191b809fc1b.productIntroEn: PackRat helps outdoor travelers plan trips and build better packing lists. Search a large catalog of outdoor gear by keyword or natural language, compare products on weight and price, and assemble packing lists that are analyzed for total weight with a base, worn, and consumable breakdown.
plugin_asdk_app_6a777414cb308191b809fc1b.longDescription: PackRat helps outdoor travelers plan trips and build better packing lists. Search a large catalog of outdoor gear by keyword or natural language, compare products on weight and price, and assemble packing lists that are analyzed for total weight with a base, worn, and consumable breakdown. Ask for lighter alternatives to the heaviest items, find gaps for a specific trip, check the near-term weather forecast for a destination, browse outdoor guides, and save trips and packs to a PackRat account that syncs with the mobile app.
plugin_asdk_app_6a777414cb308191b809fc1b.longDescriptionZh: PackRat 帮助户外旅行者计划旅行并制定更好的装箱单。通过关键词或自然语言搜索户外装备的大型目录，比较产品的重量和价格，并整理装箱清单，分析总重量以及基础、磨损和消耗品明细。寻求较轻的替代品来代替最重的物品，查找特定旅行的间隙，检查目的地的近期天气预报，浏览户外指南，并将旅行和背包保存到与移动应用程序同步的 PackRat 帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a905ee4f308819189ce7914.productIntro: CatamaranSite列出了全球销售的双体船—帆船和动力，从 国际经纪公司和出售自己船只的私人业主。
plugin_asdk_app_6a905ee4f308819189ce7914.productIntroEn: CatamaranSite lists catamarans for sale worldwide — sailing and power, from international brokerages and from private owners selling their own boat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a905ee4f308819189ce7914.longDescription:
CatamaranSite lists catamarans for sale worldwide — sailing and power, from
international brokerages and from private owners selling their own boat.

Ask for what you actually want and the connector searches the live catalogue:
builder, model, asking price, length, year, number of cabins, cruising area, and
sail or power. Results come back as cards you can look through without leaving the
conversation — photographs, asking price, length, cabins and where the boat is
lying. Tap one and the full listing opens in place, with the description, the
specification and whether you are dealing with a broker or the owner.

You can also put two to four boats side by side on the specifications that
actually decide between them, or ask which builders currently have boats for sale
before you have narrowed anything down.

Everything is read-only and nothing is submitted on your behalf. When you want to
enquire, the connector links you to the listing on catamaransite.com, where the
seller's own contact form is.

Only boats currently for sale are searchable. Sold and withdrawn listings are
excluded, as are their prices.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa0052ad3648191b2cd05ec.productIntroEn: Vacanța România helps you discover verified tourist attractions across Romania: natural sites, castles and fortresses, monasteries and churches, museums, and hiking areas. plugin_asdk_app_6aa0052ad3648191b2cd05ec.longDescription: Vacanța România helps you discover verified tourist attractions across Romania: natural sites, castles and fortresses, monasteries and churches, museums, and hiking areas. Ask what to visit in a county or town, what is near you within a chosen radius, or explore by theme — nature, history, culture, lesser-known places. Every result comes with a short description in Romanian or English, the county and locality, coordinates, and a link to the full page on vacantaromania.ro (holidayinromania.com in English), so you can read more, see photos and plan the trip. The data is a curated database of published attractions, kept up to date by the Vacanța România team. No account is needed and nothing about you is stored.
